sents.zh: 为了将这些模型应用于我们的评估，我们计算变更请求向量与所有需求向量之间的接近程度，并选择相似度得分最高的需求作为受影响的需求。

paragraphs.en: For both LSI and pre-trained embedding models, the impact set is identified based on similarity scores. Therefore, a threshold strategy is required to determine the cutoff point above which requirements are considered impacted. To enable a comprehensive evaluation, we consider two threshold strategies, T 1 T_{1} and T 2 T_{2} , which were selected based on their reported performance in previous studies ( Etezadi et al., 2026a ; Etezadi et al., 2025 ; Sauvola and Pietikäinen, 2000 ) . For T 1 T_{1} , requirements are ranked in descending order based on their cosine similarity scores with the change rationale. The cutoff point is then determined by identifying the largest drop between two consecutive similarity scores in the ranked list. The higher similarity score associated with this drop is selected as the threshold. All requirements with similarity scores above this threshold are selected as the final impact set. For T 2 T_{2} , the threshold is based on the mean and standard deviation of all similarity values produced. Specifically, we calculate the mean similarity score across all requirements, along with the standard deviation. A requirement is considered impacted if its similarity score is above the threshold of mean + standard deviation \text{mean}+\text{standard deviation} . This strategy adapts the threshold to the score distribution associated with each change rationale rather than relying on a fixed threshold. Both threshold strategies are applied to LSI, SBERT, and LLM-Vec.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 LSI 和预训练嵌入模型，影响集都是基于相似度得分来确定的。 因此，需要一种阈值策略来确定截止点，高于该截止点的需求被视为受影响的需求。 为了进行全面评估，我们考虑了两种阈值策略 T 1 T_{1} 和 T 2 T_{2} ，它们是基于在以往研究中报告的性能而选择的（Etezadi et al., 2026a；Etezadi et al., 2025；Sauvola and Pietikäinen, 2000）。 对于 T 1 T_{1} ，需求按照其与变更理由的余弦相似度得分降序排列。 然后通过找出排序列表中两个相邻相似度得分之间的最大跌幅来确定截止点。 与该跌幅相关联的较高相似度得分被选为阈值。 所有相似度得分高于该阈值的需求被选为最终影响集。 对于 T 2 T_{2} ，阈值基于所产生的所有相似度值的均值和标准差。 具体而言，我们计算所有需求的平均相似度得分以及标准差。 如果一个需求的相似度得分高于 均值 + 标准差 \text{均值 + 标准差} 这一阈值，则该需求被视为受影响。 该策略使阈值能够适应与每个变更理由相关的得分分布，而不是依赖于固定阈值。 两种阈值策略均应用于 LSI、SBERT 和 LLM-Vec。

paragraphs.en: ProReFiCIA is an LLM-based approach that identifies change-impacted requirements ( Etezadi et al., 2025 ) . ProReFiCIA first explores different LLMs and prompt configurations to identify the most effective model–prompt combination, which is then applied to the complete set of requirements to generate an initial impact set. We then refine the result by applying the previously identified optimal configuration to the remaining requirements not identified in the initial pass, mitigating the lost-in-the-middle effect ( Liu et al., 2024 ) and recovering potentially missed impacted requirements. The candidate impact sets are subsequently combined and passed to a filtering stage, where an LLM ranks the candidates according to the LLM’s confidence in their impact. In this stage, a Natural Language Inference (NLI) ( Jurafsky and Martin, 2026 ) model also filters the ranked requirements. The NLI model is fine-tuned using change requests as premises and candidate requirements along with their justifications as hypotheses, enabling it to filter out irrelevant candidates. Combining the ranking stage with NLI-based filtering in order to improve precision. We use ProReFiCIA as one of our baselines because it is a recently proposed, well-performing LLM-based approach for the CIA task. It focuses on improving recall, given the importance of identifying impacted requirements. This focus makes ProReFiCIA relevant to our evaluation. To apply ProReFiCIA, we use the same model–prompt combination introduced in the original paper ( Etezadi et al., 2025 ) . To fine-tune the NLI model, we employ a leave-one-out strategy, where the model is fine-tuned on two datasets and evaluated on the remaining dataset.
paragraphs.zh: ProReFiCIA 是一种基于大语言模型的方法，用于识别受变更影响的需求（Etezadi et al., 2025）。 ProReFiCIA 首先探索不同的大语言模型和提示词配置，以确定最有效的模型—提示词组合，然后将该组合应用于完整的需求集合，生成初始影响集。 然后，我们通过将先前确定的最优配置应用于初始遍历中未被识别的其余需求来改进结果，以缓解“中间丢失”效应（Liu et al., 2024），并找回可能被遗漏的受影响需求。 随后，候选影响集被合并并传递到过滤阶段，在该阶段中，大语言模型根据其对各候选需求受变更影响的置信度对候选需求进行排序。 在该阶段中，一个自然语言推理（NLI）（Jurafsky and Martin, 2026）模型也会对排序后的需求进行过滤。 该 NLI 模型使用变更请求作为前提、候选需求及其理由作为假设进行微调，使其能够过滤掉不相关的候选需求。 将排序阶段与基于 NLI 的过滤相结合，以提升精确率。 我们将 ProReFiCIA 作为基线之一，因为它是最近提出的、在 CIA 任务上表现良好的基于大语言模型的方法。 鉴于识别受影响需求的重要性，它侧重于提升召回率。 这一关注点使 ProReFiCIA 与我们的评估具有相关性。 为了应用 ProReFiCIA，我们使用原论文中介绍的相同模型—提示词组合（Etezadi et al., 2025）。 为了微调 NLI 模型，我们采用留一法策略，即在两个数据集上对模型进行微调，并在剩余的数据集上进行评估。

sents.zh: ProReFiCIA 是一种基于大语言模型的方法，用于识别受变更影响的需求（Etezadi et al., 2025）。

sents.en: We use ProReFiCIA as one of our baselines because it is a recently proposed, well-performing LLM-based approach for the CIA task.
sents.zh: 我们将 ProReFiCIA 作为基线之一，因为它是最近提出的、在 CIA 任务上表现良好的基于大语言模型的方法。

sents.en: It focuses on improving recall, given the importance of identifying impacted requirements.
sents.zh: 鉴于识别受影响需求的重要性，它侧重于提升召回率。

sents.en: This focus makes ProReFiCIA relevant to our evaluation.
sents.zh: 这一关注点使 ProReFiCIA 与我们的评估具有相关性。

sents.en: To apply ProReFiCIA, we use the same model–prompt combination introduced in the original paper ( Etezadi et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 为了应用 ProReFiCIA，我们使用原论文中介绍的相同模型—提示词组合（Etezadi et al., 2025）。

sents.en: To fine-tune the NLI model, we employ a leave-one-out strategy, where the model is fine-tuned on two datasets and evaluated on the remaining dataset.
sents.zh: 为了微调 NLI 模型，我们采用留一法策略，即在两个数据集上对模型进行微调，并在剩余的数据集上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: RE-RAG. The agent employed for RE-RAG was LLaMa 3.1 70B . The model was deployed locally using the Ollama v(0.6.1) library across two NVIDIA L40S GPUs, each equipped with 48 GB of RAM. For such smaller LLMs, temperatures that are superior to zero introduce a degree of variability that can be beneficial for text retrieval and reasoning tasks ( Li et al., 2025 ) . We set a temperature of 0.4 to maintain moderate variability.
paragraphs.zh: RE-RAG。 用于RE-RAG的智能体是LLaMa 3.1 70B。 该模型使用Ollama v(0.6.1)库在两块NVIDIA L40S GPU上本地部署，每块GPU配备48 GB内存。 对于此类较小的LLM，高于零的温度会引入一定程度的可变性，这对文本检索和推理任务可能是有益的（Li et al., 2025）。 我们将温度设置为0.4，以保持适度的可变性。

paragraphs.en: Generator Agents. Claude Sonnet and GPT-4o were employed as the Generator Agents in DRILS , accessed via API calls to Anthropic and OpenAI, respectively. Both models were configured with a max_output_tokens limit of 4,000. For GPT-4o , we set a temperature of 0 as it provides more deterministic outputs, which are suitable for its large-scale capabilities as well as the task at hand which requires strong instruction-following and stable outputs ( Li et al., 2025 ) . The Claude API does not support temperature configuration. All API interactions were managed through the LangChain v(1.3.4) library.
paragraphs.zh: 生成器智能体。 在 DRILS 中，Claude Sonnet 和 GPT-4o 被用作生成器智能体，分别通过调用 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的 API 进行访问。 两个模型均配置了 4,000 的 max_output_tokens 上限。 对于 GPT-4o，我们将 temperature 设为 0，因为它能提供更确定性的输出，这既适合其大规模能力，也适合当前需要强指令遵循能力和稳定输出的任务（Li et al., 2025）。 Claude API 不支持 temperature 配置。 所有 API 交互均通过 LangChain v(1.3.4) 库进行管理。

paragraphs.en: LSI. The LSI model was implemented using the scikit-learn v(1.9.0) library. The model was trained on all sections of the SRS documents. We first preprocessed the input texts through normalization and lemmatization. A term-document matrix was then constructed using TF-IDF weighting. The similarity between a query requirement and candidate requirements was measured using cosine similarity.
paragraphs.zh: LSI。 LSI模型是使用scikit-learn v(1.9.0)库实现的。 该模型在SRS文档的所有章节上进行了训练。 我们首先通过规范化（normalization）和词形还原（lemmatization）对输入文本进行预处理。 随后使用TF-IDF加权构建了词项-文档矩阵。 查询需求与候选需求之间的相似度采用余弦相似度进行度量。

paragraphs.en: SBERT. The SBERT baseline was implemented using the SentenceTransformer v(5.5.1) library. Specifically, we used the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 , a pretrained BERT-based sentence encoder, to generate the embeddings for requirements and change requests. We then computed the cosine similarity between the change request and all requirement pairs. We selected this model for its well-demonstrated balance of computational efficiency and effectiveness in capturing semantic similarity ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019b ) .
paragraphs.zh: SBERT。 SBERT 基线使用 SentenceTransformer v(5.5.1) 库实现。 具体而言，我们使用了 all-MiniLM-L6-v2，这是一个基于 BERT 的预训练句子编码器，用于生成需求与变更请求的嵌入表示。 然后，我们计算了变更请求与所有需求对之间的余弦相似度。 我们选择该模型是因为它在计算效率与捕获语义相似度的有效性之间展现出了良好的平衡（Reimers and Gurevych, 2019b）。

paragraphs.en: LLM-Vec. The LLM-Vec baseline was implemented using the SentenceTransformersv(5.5.1) library. The infgrad/Jasper-Token-Compression-600M embedding model was selected because it achieved the highest average score across tasks on the Massive Textual Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) leaderboard 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/spaces/mteb/leaderboard . The model was used to encode both change requests and requirements into dense vector embeddings, with pairwise similarity computed using the cosine similarity metric.
paragraphs.zh: LLM-Vec。 LLM-Vec 基线是使用 SentenceTransformersv（5.5.1）库实现的。 选择 infgrad/Jasper-Token-Compression-600M 嵌入模型，是因为它在海量文本嵌入基准（MTEB）排行榜 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/spaces/mteb/leaderboard 上的各任务平均得分最高。 该模型被用于将变更请求和需求编码为稠密向量嵌入，并使用余弦相似度度量计算成对相似度。

paragraphs.en: For the empirical evaluation, we employ a diverse set of metrics, covering three categories: (1) performance metrics, which evaluate how well a certain configuration or approach performs on the CIA task, (2) operational metrics, which assess the practical effectiveness and cost of an approach, and (3) a statistical test, which evaluates whether the differences in performance between the evaluated approaches are statistically significant. As performance metrics, we compute Recall , Precision , and F 1 F_{1} score . As operational metrics, we compute Effectiveness and the Cost for the analyst to validate the predicted impact set. Finally, we use Fisher’s Exact test ( Fisher, 1922 ) to test statistical significance. The description of these metrics is provided in the following sections.
paragraphs.zh: 在实证评估中，我们采用了多样化的指标集，涵盖三个类别：(1) 性能指标，用于评估某种配置或方法在 CIA 任务上的表现好坏；(2) 运营指标，用于评估方法的实际有效性和成本；(3) 统计检验，用于评估被评估方法之间的性能差异是否具有统计学显著性。 作为性能指标，我们计算召回率（Recall）、精确率（Precision）和 F1 分数（F_{1} score）。 作为运营指标，我们计算分析师验证预测影响集的有效性（Effectiveness）和成本（Cost）。 最后，我们使用 Fisher 精确检验（Fisher, 1922）来检验统计显著性。 这些指标的描述将在以下章节中给出。

paragraphs.en: Recall (R). Recall measures the proportion of actual positive instances (i.e., impacted requirements) that a model correctly identifies, reflecting its ability to avoid missing relevant cases. The recall is formally expressed in Equation 1 , where true positives (TP) represent correctly identified impacted requirements and false negatives (FN) represent impacted requirements that are incorrectly identified as non-impacted.
paragraphs.zh: 召回率（R）。 召回率衡量模型正确识别出的真实正例（即受影响需求）所占的比例，反映其避免遗漏相关案例的能力。 召回率的形式化表达见公式1，其中真正例（TP）表示被正确识别的受影响需求，假负例（FN）表示被错误识别为未受影响的受影响需求。

paragraphs.en: Effectiveness (Eff). Effectiveness assesses how well the retrieved impact set captures all impacted requirements. It is measured using macro-averaged recall, which averages recall across all change requests, ensuring each change request contributes equally to the final score regardless of how many impacted requirements it contains ( Etezadi et al., 2025 ) . This metric represents, on average, the proportion of impacted requirements successfully identified within the impact set. Effectiveness is formally expressed in Equation 4 , where N c N_{c} represents the total number of change requests in the dataset, T ​ P c i TP_{c_{i}} denotes the number of true positives in the impact set for a change request c i c_{i} , and F ​ N c i FN_{c_{i}} denotes the number of false negatives, i.e., impacted requirements that were not included in the impact set for change request c i c_{i} .
paragraphs.zh: 有效性（Eff）。 有效性评估检索到的变更影响集在多大程度上捕获了所有受影响的需求。 它采用宏平均召回率来度量，即对所有变更请求的召回率取平均，确保每个变更请求对最终得分的贡献相等，而无论其包含多少受影响的需求（Etezadi et al., 2025）。 该指标表示平均而言在变更影响集中成功识别出的受影响需求的比例。 有效性的形式化表达见公式4，其中 N c N_{c} 表示数据集中变更请求的总数，T​P c i TP_{c_{i}} 表示变更请求 c i c_{i} 的变更影响集中真阳性的数量，F​N c i FN_{c_{i}} 表示假阴性的数量，即未被纳入变更请求 c i c_{i} 变更影响集的受影响需求。

sents.en: Effectiveness is formally expressed in Equation 4 , where N c N_{c} represents the total number of change requests in the dataset, T ​ P c i TP_{c_{i}} denotes the number of true positives in the impact set for a change request c i c_{i} , and F ​ N c i FN_{c_{i}} denotes the number of false negatives, i.e., impacted requirements that were not included in the impact set for change request c i c_{i} .
sents.zh: 有效性的形式化表达见公式4，其中 N c N_{c} 表示数据集中变更请求的总数，T​P c i TP_{c_{i}} 表示变更请求 c i c_{i} 的变更影响集中真阳性的数量，F​N c i FN_{c_{i}} 表示假阴性的数量，即未被纳入变更请求 c i c_{i} 变更影响集的受影响需求。

paragraphs.en: Cost. Cost is a surrogate measure of the effort required for the requirements analyst to validate the identified impact set, quantified as the proportion of requirements that must be reviewed ( Etezadi et al., 2025 ) . Cost is computed by calculating the macro-averaged proportion of retrieved requirements relative to the total number of requirements in the dataset, averaged across all change requests. A lower cost indicates that the model retrieves a more focused and compact impact set, thereby reducing the manual validation burden on the requirements analyst. The cost is formally expressed in Equation 5 , where N c N_{c} represents the total number of change requests in the dataset, T ​ P c i TP_{c_{i}} and F ​ P c i FP_{c_{i}} represent the number of true positives and false positives retrieved in the impact set for a change request c i c_{i} , respectively, and N r ​ e ​ q N_{req} denotes the total number of requirements in the dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 成本。 成本是需求分析人员验证已识别影响集所需工作量的替代度量，量化为必须评审的需求所占的比例（Etezadi et al., 2025）。 成本通过计算检索出的需求数量相对于数据集中需求总数的宏平均比例来得出，并对所有变更请求取平均。 成本越低，表明模型检索到的影响集更加聚焦且紧凑，从而减轻需求分析人员的人工验证负担。 成本在公式5中正式表达，其中 N c N_{c} 表示数据集中变更请求的总数，T ​ P c i TP_{c_{i}} 和 F ​ P c i FP_{c_{i}} 分别表示为变更请求 c i c_{i} 检索到的影响集中真正例和假正例的数量，N r ​ e ​ q N_{req} 表示数据集中需求的总数。

paragraphs.en: Fisher’s Exact test. Fisher’s exact test is a statistical test used to determine whether there is a statistically significant association between two categorical variables ( Fisher, 1922 ) . This test is primarily designed for datasets with small sample sizes, sparse data, or when more than twenty percent of the table cells have expected counts below five. Moreover, testing for an association between two categorical variables using Fisher’s Exact Test is mathematically equivalent to testing whether the proportion of an outcome differs between two groups. Therefore, we use this test to assess whether the differences in recall and precision between two approaches are statistically significant. Specifically, it determines whether the observed differences in precision and recall are associated with differences in the TP versus FP (for precision) and TP versus FN (for recall) proportions, respectively, under the null hypothesis that the two approaches yield identical proportions.
paragraphs.zh: Fisher精确检验。 Fisher精确检验是一种统计检验，用于确定两个分类变量之间是否存在统计学上显著的关联（Fisher, 1922）。 该检验主要适用于样本量较小、数据稀疏、或超过百分之二十的表格单元格的期望计数低于五的数据集。 此外，使用Fisher精确检验来检验两个分类变量之间的关联，在数学上等价于检验某一结果的比例在两组之间是否存在差异。 因此，我们使用该检验来评估两种方法之间在召回率和精确率上的差异是否具有统计学显著性。 具体而言，在两种方法产生相同比例的原假设下，该检验分别确定精确率和召回率上观察到的差异是否与TP对FP（针对精确率）以及TP对FN（针对召回率）的比例差异相关联。

paragraphs.en: This RQ investigates the impact of the auxiliary information that the Generator Agents provide as input to the Judge Agent and the extent to which it affects its final impact set selection. The auxiliary information refers to the supplementary outputs generated by the Generator Agents , beyond their prediction of whether a requirement is impacted by the change request. This information was explicitly requested in the main prompt, as illustrated in Figure 6 , and comprises three elements: (1) Rationale (R) , which provides textual evidence explaining the reason behind the agent’s selection of a given requirement, (2) Change Location (CL) , which specifies the specific part of the requirement that should be modified in response to the given change request, and (3) Confidence Score (CS) , a value ranging from 1 to 5 that reflects the agent’s confidence in its prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究问题考察生成器智能体作为输入提供给裁判智能体的辅助信息所产生的影响，以及该信息在多大程度上影响其最终的影响集选择。 辅助信息是指生成器智能体在其对某需求是否受变更请求影响的预测之外所生成的补充输出。 该信息在主提示词中被明确要求提供，如图6所示，包含三个要素：(1) 理由（R），提供文本证据以解释该智能体选择某一需求的原因；(2) 变更位置（CL），指定需求中应针对给定变更请求进行修改的具体部分；(3) 置信度分数（CS），一个介于1到5之间的数值，反映该智能体对其预测的信心程度。

sents.en: This RQ investigates the impact of the auxiliary information that the Generator Agents provide as input to the Judge Agent and the extent to which it affects its final impact set selection.
sents.zh: 本研究问题考察生成器智能体作为输入提供给裁判智能体的辅助信息所产生的影响，以及该信息在多大程度上影响其最终的影响集选择。

sents.zh: 该信息在主提示词中被明确要求提供，如图6所示，包含三个要素：(1) 理由（R），提供文本证据以解释该智能体选择某一需求的原因；(2) 变更位置（CL），指定需求中应针对给定变更请求进行修改的具体部分；(3) 置信度分数（CS），一个介于1到5之间的数值，反映该智能体对其预测的信心程度。

paragraphs.en: To examine the effect of each of these elements on the Judge Agent ’s decision-making, we define five experimental settings in which different auxiliary information elements are excluded from the Judge Agent ’s input: (1) DRILS-w/o-R , where only the rationale is removed, (2) DRILS-w/o-CL , where only the change location is removed, (3) DRILS-w/o-CS , where only the confidence score is removed, (4) DRILS-w/o-(R-CL-CS) , where the rationale, change location, and confidence score are removed, and (5) DRILS , where none of this information is removed. To implement these variations, for each dataset, we first run the first three steps of DRILS and store the Generator Agents ’ outputs. We then iteratively remove the auxiliary information corresponding to each experimental setting from these stored outputs before passing them to the Judge Agent . Therefore, we re-execute only the Judge Agent across different input variations. This ensures that the only difference between the experimental settings is the presence or absence of the auxiliary information in question. Table 2 presents results for the five experimental settings across recall, precision, F 1 F_{1} score, effectiveness, and cost.
paragraphs.zh: 为了考察这些要素各自对裁判智能体（Judge Agent）决策的影响，我们定义了五种实验设置，在这些设置中从裁判智能体的输入中排除不同的辅助信息要素：(1) DRILS-w/o-R，仅移除推理依据（rationale），(2) DRILS-w/o-CL，仅移除变更位置（change location），(3) DRILS-w/o-CS，仅移除置信分数（confidence score），(4) DRILS-w/o-(R-CL-CS)，移除推理依据、变更位置和置信分数，以及 (5) DRILS，不移除任何此类信息。 为了实现这些变体，对于每个数据集，我们首先运行 DRILS 的前三个步骤，并存储各生成智能体（Generator Agent）的输出。 然后，我们在将这些已存储的输出传递给裁判智能体之前，迭代地从中移除与每种实验设置对应的辅助信息。 因此，我们在不同的输入变体下只重新执行裁判智能体。 这确保了各实验设置之间的唯一差异就是相关辅助信息的有无。 表 2 展示了五种实验设置在召回率、精确率、F 1 F_{1} 分数、有效性和成本方面的结果。

paragraphs.en: Note that these experiments specifically target the sensitivity of the Judge Agent to each element of input auxiliary information and do not examine how removing such information from the Generator Agents ’ prompts affects their impact set identification. This distinction matters because prior studies show that, even when the input and prompt remain unchanged, variations in output format or the inclusion of additional information within the output structure can affect LLM performance ( Xu et al., 2024b ) . Furthermore, for this RQ and all remaining RQs, we ran each configuration three times to ensure experimental robustness and reliable results. The reported results represent the mean across the three runs, along with the corresponding standard deviation.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，这些实验专门针对评审智能体对输入辅助信息各要素的敏感性，并未考察从生成智能体的提示中移除此类信息会如何影响其影响集识别。 这一区别之所以重要，是因为先前的研究表明，即使输入和提示保持不变，输出格式的变化或输出结构中包含额外信息也会影响大语言模型的性能（Xu et al., 2024b）。 此外，对于本研究问题及所有剩余的研究问题，我们将每种配置运行三次，以确保实验的稳健性和结果的可靠性。 报告的结果为三次运行的平均值，以及相应的标准差。

paragraphs.en: As Table 2 shows, when comparing DRILS with DRILS-w/o-R , the average F 1 F_{1} score across the three datasets decreases from 80.9% to 72.5%, a 10.4% relative decrease that indicates substantial performance degradation when the rationale is removed. Regarding recall, the results vary across datasets. Both experimental settings achieve the same recall on D1, DRILS-w/o-R performs better on D2, and DRILS performs better on D3. In fact, the average recall across the three datasets is relatively similar for the two settings, reaching 85.2% for DRILS-w/o-R and 87.1% for DRILS . The main difference lies in precision, which averages 63.53% for DRILS-w/o-R and 76.3% for DRILS . The difference is especially notable for D2, where precision drops from 86.2% to 58.6% without the rationale. These results suggest that the rationale plays a particularly critical role in guiding the Judge Agent toward more precise impact set selection. Without access to the justifications provided by the Generator Agents , the Judge Agent lacks insight into why certain requirements were identified as impacted and may infer a different rationale, potentially leading it to incorrectly assess the generator’s decision as illogical. In contrast, providing the rationale gives the Judge Agent additional evidence to correctly and critically assess whether the proposed selection is logically justified.
paragraphs.zh: 如表2所示，将DRILS与DRILS-w/o-R进行比较时，三个数据集上的平均F₁得分从80.9%下降到72.5%，相对下降10.4%，这表明移除理由后性能出现显著下降。 在召回率方面，各数据集的结果有所不同。 两种实验设置在D1上取得了相同的召回率，DRILS-w/o-R在D2上表现更好，而DRILS在D3上表现更好。 事实上，两种设置在三个数据集上的平均召回率相对接近，DRILS-w/o-R为85.2%，DRILS为87.1%。 主要差异在于精确率，DRILS-w/o-R的平均精确率为63.53%，而DRILS为76.3%。 这一差异在D2上尤为显著，在没有理由的情况下，精确率从86.2%下降到58.6%。 这些结果表明，理由在引导智能体（Judge Agent）进行更精确的影响集选择方面起着尤为关键的作用。 在无法获取生成智能体（Generator Agents）所提供依据的情况下，智能体（Judge Agent）无法了解某些需求为何被判定为受影响，可能会推断出不同的理由，从而可能导致其错误地认为生成器的决策不合逻辑。 相反，提供理由能为智能体（Judge Agent）提供额外的证据，使其能够正确且审慎地评估所提出的选择在逻辑上是否合理。

paragraphs.en: Regarding operational metrics, effectiveness is similar across the two settings, though slightly higher when the rationale is included. It reached 89.7% for DRILS compared with 86.8% for DRILS-w/o-R . In contrast, the cost is consistently lower when the rationale is included. This lower cost, combined with the higher precision, suggests that providing the rationale enables the Judge Agent to make more accurate selections while requiring fewer resources.

paragraphs.en: The results of removing the change location are captured in Table 2 under the DRILS-w/o-CL setting. Removing the change location results in an average F 1 F_{1} score of 83.1% across datasets, which is slightly higher than the 80.9% achieved by DRILS . However, a closer look at the individual metrics shows that this F 1 F_{1} score improvement is driven primarily by higher precision, while average recall declines from 87.1% to 84.1%. This suggests that without the change location, the Judge Agent becomes more conservative in its selections, identifying a smaller but more precise set of impacted requirements. This may be because the impact of a change can sometimes be implicit in the requirement text and it becomes apparent only when the change location is explicitly provided to the Judge Agent . While this reduces false positives, it also causes the system to miss actual impacted requirements. Therefore, although removing change location appears beneficial for the F 1 F_{1} score, the decline in recall suggests this information plays an important role in predicting a complete identified impact set. Given that missing impacted requirements can be more detrimental to CIA than including a small number of additional requirements, recall is prioritized over precision for this task. Thus, the change location is considered an important element of auxiliary information.
paragraphs.zh: 移除变更位置的实验结果记录在表 2 中，对应 DRILS-w/o-CL 设置。 移除变更位置后，各数据集上的平均 F 1 F_{1} 分数为 83.1%，略高于 DRILS 取得的 80.9%。 然而，仔细观察各项指标可以发现，这一 F 1 F_{1} 分数的提升主要来自更高的精确率，而平均召回率则从 87.1% 下降到 84.1%。 这表明在没有变更位置的情况下，Judge 智能体在选择时变得更加保守，识别出的受影响需求集合更小但更精确。 这可能是因为变更的影响有时隐含在需求文本之中，只有在向 Judge 智能体明确提供变更位置时才会显现出来。 虽然这减少了误报，但也导致系统遗漏了实际受影响的需求。 因此，尽管移除变更位置似乎有利于 F 1 F_{1} 分数，但召回率的下降表明这一信息在预测完整的已识别影响集合方面发挥着重要作用。 鉴于遗漏受影响需求比纳入少量额外需求对 CIA 造成的危害更大，该任务更看重召回率而非精确率。 因此，变更位置被视为辅助信息中的一个重要要素。

The overall cost increase is due to the lower precision caused by including the change location.

paragraphs.en: Overall, given the higher recall associated with including the change location, we consider it a relevant element of the Judge Agent ’s input, particularly for improving the completeness of the identified impact set.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，鉴于包含变更位置能带来更高的召回率，我们认为它是 Judge 智体输入的一个相关要素，尤其有助于提高所识别影响集的完整性。

paragraphs.en: The results of DRILS-w/o-CS across all datasets are presented in Table 2 . The average F 1 F_{1} scores for DRILS-w/o-CS and DRILS are 79.8% and 80.9%, respectively, reflecting a slight decline in overall performance upon removal of the confidence score. A closer examination of the results of individual datasets reveals that the effect of removing the confidence score is different across datasets. Specifically, when the confidence score is removed, recall remains the same on D1, increases by 1.7 percentage points on D2, and decreases by 7.4 percentage points on D3. Furthermore, precision decreases by 13.3 percentage points on D2, and increases by 4.2 and 7.6 percentage points on D1 and D3, respectively. These results suggest that the effect of including the confidence score is more pronounced when its effect is positive, i.e., when DRILS achieves higher performance than DRILS-w/o-CS . In contrast, when DRILS-w/o-CS performs better, the difference between the two settings is smaller, suggesting that the negative effect of including the confidence score is limited. Removing the confidence score slightly reduces both average recall and average precision, with recall decreasing from 76.3% to 75.8% and precision from 87.1% to 85.2%. Among the auxiliary information elements considered, the confidence score has the smallest overall effect on the performance metrics.

paragraphs.en: Unlike the rationale and change location, the confidence score is a single integer rather than a chunk of text. Nevertheless, beyond its relatively small influence on the Judge Agent ’s decisions, it serves as an implicit quality signal for the other pieces of auxiliary information produced by the Generator Agents . Specifically, a low confidence score may indicate that the accompanying rationale or change location is less reliable, providing the Judge Agent with a means of weighing the trustworthiness of the information it receives. The confidence score therefore enriches the overall information context available to the Judge Agent , enabling more calibrated decision-making. Removing it leaves the Judge Agent without information about the reliability of other auxiliary information, which may explain the slight performance degradation observed across datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 与理由和修改位置不同，置信度分数是一个单一的整数，而不是一段文本。 尽管如此，除了对裁判智能体的决策影响相对较小之外，它还作为生成智能体所产生的其他辅助信息的隐式质量信号。 具体而言，较低的置信度分数可能表明随附的理由或修改位置不太可靠，从而为裁判智能体提供了一种衡量其所收信息可信度的手段。 因此，置信度分数丰富了裁判智能体可用的整体信息上下文，使其决策更加校准。 移除它会使裁判智能体无法获知其他辅助信息的可靠性，这或许可以解释在各数据集上观察到的轻微性能下降。

paragraphs.en: Regarding operational metrics, effectiveness varies across datasets, with both settings achieving the same effectiveness on D1, DRILS-w/o-CS achieving a higher score on D2, and DRILS achieving a higher score on D3. When averaging across datasets, DRILS achieves a higher score of 89.7% than 86.8% for DRILS-w/o-CS , with effectiveness exceeding 90% on two datasets. This difference is more pronounced than for the other metrics and may be because the confidence score indicates how confident each Generator Agent is in its annotation. This information can help the Judge Agent make a more informed decision when choosing between annotations in cases where the Generator Agents disagree, thereby supporting a more effective decision-making process. Regarding cost, both settings have an average cost of 6% across datasets. However, DRILS is more consistent across datasets, ranging from 5.1% to 6.9%, compared with 4.7% to 8.4% for DRILS-w/o-CS .

paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，虽然各项结果因指标和数据集而异，且性能差异普遍较小，但在加入置信度分数后各平均指标略有提升，加之其有助于对输出结果进行分析，因此它是作为输入提供给 Judge 智能体的辅助信息中的一个相关要素。

paragraphs.en: In this final setting, all three types of auxiliary information (i.e., the rationale, change location, and confidence score) are simultaneously removed from the Judge Agent ’s input. The DRILS-w/o-(R-CL-CS) setting represents a scenario in which the Judge Agent is provided only with the annotations produced by the Generator Agents , without information about why or how a requirement is affected by the change request or how confident the Generator Agents are in their annotations. As shown in Table 2 , the DRILS-w/o-(R-CL-CS) setting achieves the lowest F 1 F_{1} scores and recall values compared with all other settings across all three datasets, with an average F 1 F_{1} score and recall of 70.2% and 71.6%, compared with 80.9% and 87.1% for DRILS . This corresponds to relative decreases of 13.12% and 17.80% in F 1 F_{1} score and recall, respectively, representing the largest performance declines observed across all settings. Average precision is also lower for DRILS-w/o-(R-CL-CS) at 69.7% compared with 76.3% for DRILS . Effectiveness also decreases, with DRILS-w/o-(R-CL-CS) achieving the lowest average of 79.8%, compared with 89.7% for DRILS . In contrast, the two settings have similar costs, averaging about 6% each.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一最终设置中，三类辅助信息（即理由、变更位置和置信度分数）同时从 Judge Agent 的输入中移除。 DRILS-w/o-(R-CL-CS) 设置代表这样一种场景：Judge Agent 仅获得由 Generator Agents 产生的标注，而没有任何关于需求为何以及如何受到变更请求影响、以及 Generator Agents 对其标注置信程度的信息。 如表 2 所示，与所有其他设置相比，DRILS-w/o-(R-CL-CS) 设置在全部三个数据集上取得了最低的 F 1 F_{1} 分数和召回率，平均 F 1 F_{1} 分数和召回率分别为 70.2% 和 71.6%，而 DRILS 则为 80.9% 和 87.1%。 这对应于 F 1 F_{1} 分数和召回率分别相对下降 13.12% 和 17.80%，是所有设置中观察到的最大性能下降。 DRILS-w/o-(R-CL-CS) 的平均精确率也更低，为 69.7%，而 DRILS 为 76.3%。 有效性同样下降，DRILS-w/o-(R-CL-CS) 取得了最低的平均值 79.8%，而 DRILS 为 89.7%。 相比之下，两种设置的成本相近，平均各约为 6%。

paragraphs.en: These results indicate that while each individual element of auxiliary information may have a moderate effect on the Judge Agent ’s decision-making, their combined presence has a substantially greater effect on almost all evaluated metrics. The substantial performance drop when removing all auxiliary information suggests that the rationale, change location, and confidence score complement one another, and that their combined presence is essential for the Judge Agent to accurately identify the final impact set.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，虽然每种辅助信息单独来看对裁判智能体的决策只有中等程度的影响，但它们组合在一起时，对几乎所有评估指标都产生了显著更大的影响。 移除全部辅助信息后性能大幅下降，这表明理由、变更位置和置信度分数能够相互补充，它们的共同存在对裁判智能体准确识别最终影响集至关重要。

paragraphs.en: To ensure the robustness of the results, we ran each configuration three times and report the deviation across runs. As Table 2 shows, the average of the deviations across all settings and datasets is 0.027. Among the 75 experimental results, 21.3% exhibit no variation across runs (i.e., a deviation of 0.00), while 88% have a deviation below 0.05. Only a few instances exceed 0.05: 0.06 in three instances and 0.08 and 0.09 in one instance each. DRILS demonstrates high stability across runs, with deviations below 0.05 for 14 of the 15 metric–dataset combinations and a maximum deviation of 0.05 in the remaining case. Overall, these results indicate low variability across repeated executions for most configurations, suggesting that the obtained results are robust despite the inherent stochasticity of LLM-based approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保结果的稳健性，我们对每个配置运行了三次，并报告各次运行之间的偏差。 如表2所示，所有设置和数据集上的偏差平均值为0.027。 在75个实验结果中，21.3%在各次运行之间没有变化（即偏差为0.00），而88%的偏差低于0.05。 只有少数实例超过0.05：三个实例为0.06，各有一个实例为0.08和0.09。 DRILS 在各次运行之间表现出高稳定性，在15个指标–数据集组合中有14个的偏差低于0.05，其余一个情况的最大偏差为0.05。 总体而言，这些结果表明大多数配置在重复执行中的变异性较低，说明尽管基于LLM的方法具有固有的随机性，所获得的结果仍然是稳健的。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effects of DRILS ’s two pre-processing steps, RE-RAG and Clustering (steps 1 and 2 in the DRILS architecture presented in Figure 1 and explained in Section 2 ), we assess different settings by systematically replacing each step with alternative techniques. We compute recall, precision, F 1 F_{1} score, effectiveness, and cost to evaluate overall performance across all settings, as well as the performance of each Generator Agent individually and their union (i.e., using the combined set of requirements identified as impacted by both agents).
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估DRILS的两个预处理步骤（图1所示DRILS架构中的步骤1和步骤2，并在第2节中说明）RE-RAG和聚类的效果，我们通过系统地用替代技术替换每个步骤来评估不同的设置。 我们计算召回率、精确率、F 1 F_{1}分数、有效性和成本，以评估所有设置下的整体性能，以及每个生成器智能体各自的性能和它们的并集（即使用被两个智能体共同识别为受影响的需求的合并集合）。

sents.en: To evaluate the effects of DRILS ’s two pre-processing steps, RE-RAG and Clustering (steps 1 and 2 in the DRILS architecture presented in Figure 1 and explained in Section 2 ), we assess different settings by systematically replacing each step with alternative techniques.
sents.zh: 为了评估DRILS的两个预处理步骤（图1所示DRILS架构中的步骤1和步骤2，并在第2节中说明）RE-RAG和聚类的效果，我们通过系统地用替代技术替换每个步骤来评估不同的设置。

sents.en: We compute recall, precision, F 1 F_{1} score, effectiveness, and cost to evaluate overall performance across all settings, as well as the performance of each Generator Agent individually and their union (i.e., using the combined set of requirements identified as impacted by both agents).
sents.zh: 我们计算召回率、精确率、F 1 F_{1}分数、有效性和成本，以评估所有设置下的整体性能，以及每个生成器智能体各自的性能和它们的并集（即使用被两个智能体共同识别为受影响的需求的合并集合）。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effect of RE-RAG on the overall performance of DRILS , we assess two alternative techniques: (1) DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG , where RAG is not used within DRILS , i.e., only the original requirements are provided to the agents without additional domain-specific context, and (2) DRILS-RAG , where a standard chunk-based RAG is used. In the latter setting, the SRS documents are divided into text chunks of 1,000 tokens with an overlap of 200 tokens. These chunks are then analyzed based on their semantic similarity to the change request using the Cosine similarity metric, and the three most similar chunks are provided to the LLM as contextual information. The prompt used by the Generator Agents ( Figure 6 ) remains unchanged, except for the removal of RE-RAG-related instructions and the inclusion of the retrieved chunks in the input section of the prompt ( ## Input in Figure 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估RE-RAG对DRILS整体性能的影响，我们评估了两种替代技术：（1）DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG，即在DRILS中不使用RAG，即只向智能体提供原始需求，而不提供额外的领域特定上下文；（2）DRILS-RAG，即使用标准的基于分块的RAG。 在后一种设置中，SRS文档被划分为1,000个token、重叠200个token的文本分块。 然后使用Cosine相似度指标基于这些分块与变更请求的语义相似度进行分析，并将最相似的三个分块作为上下文信息提供给LLM。 生成器智能体（Generator Agents）所使用的提示词（图6）保持不变，仅去除了与RE-RAG相关的指令，并在提示词的输入部分（图6中的## Input）中加入了检索到的分块。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 presents the results of the two alternative settings alongside DRILS with RE-RAG. The average F 1 F_{1} score across all datasets for DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG , DRILS-RAG , and DRILS are 77.6%, 78.1%, and 80.9%, respectively. This indicates that incorporating RE-RAG slightly improves overall performance, with relative F 1 F_{1} score improvements of 4.3% and 3.6% for DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG and DRILS-RAG , respectively. While the difference is relatively small for F 1 F_{1} score, it is more pronounced for recall. DRILS with RE-RAG achieves the highest recall across all datasets, with scores above 80% on each. The largest recall gain is observed for D3, where recall increases by more than 10 percentage points. However, in D2, DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG matches the recall of DRILS with RE-RAG but is less stable, with a deviation of 0.06 compared with 0.03 for DRILS . Regarding precision, no single setting consistently achieves the highest score, as each setting obtains the highest precision on one of the three datasets. Moreover, the average precision is nearly identical across the three settings, at approximately 76%. Overall, since we prioritize recall over F 1 F_{1} score and precision for the CIA task, these results indicate that incorporating RE-RAG is beneficial for DRILS .
paragraphs.zh: 表3展示了两种替代设置与使用RE-RAG的DRILS的结果对比。 DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG、DRILS-RAG和DRILS在所有数据集上的平均F 1 F_{1}分数分别为77.6%、78.1%和80.9%。 这表明引入RE-RAG能略微提升整体性能，DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG和DRILS-RAG的相对F 1 F_{1}分数提升分别为4.3%和3.6%。 虽然在F 1 F_{1}分数上的差异相对较小，但在召回率上的差异更为明显。 使用RE-RAG的DRILS在所有数据集上都取得了最高的召回率，每个数据集上的分数均超过80%。 召回率提升最大的是D3，其召回率提高了超过10个百分点。 然而，在D2中，DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG的召回率与使用RE-RAG的DRILS持平，但稳定性较差，偏差为0.06，而DRILS的偏差为0.03。 在精确率方面，没有哪种设置能持续取得最高分数，因为每种设置都在三个数据集之一上获得了最高精确率。 此外，三种设置的平均精确率几乎相同，约为76%。 总体而言，由于在CIA任务中我们优先考虑召回率而非F 1 F_{1}分数和精确率，这些结果表明引入RE-RAG对DRILS是有益的。

sents.zh: 总体而言，由于在CIA任务中我们优先考虑召回率而非F 1 F_{1}分数和精确率，这些结果表明引入RE-RAG对DRILS是有益的。

paragraphs.en: These results indicate that RE-RAG provides domain-specific information that helps the agents identify more relevant requirements rather than improving precision. This might be because domain knowledge enables the identification of implicit links between the change request and the requirements that might not be evident from the requirement text alone. Furthermore, providing more specific information and pointers for resolving referential ambiguities, along with domain knowledge in concise bullet points, may reduce noise and irrelevant information that could confuse the LLM. In fact, DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG and DRILS-RAG achieve very similar results across the average metrics, with differences of less than one percentage point for F 1 F_{1} score and precision, and less than two percentage points for recall (77.6% and 78.1% for F 1 F_{1} score, 80.1% and 81.9% for recall, and 76.5% and 75.8% for precision). This suggests that standard RAG without the enhancements provided by RE-RAG has limited impact on the CIA task.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，RE-RAG 提供的是特定领域的信息，有助于智能体识别更相关的需求，而不是提升精确率。 这可能是因为领域知识使得能够识别变更请求与需求之间隐含的关联，而这些关联仅从需求文本本身可能并不明显。 此外，为消解指代歧义提供更具体的信息和指引，并以简洁的要点形式提供领域知识，可以减少可能使大语言模型（LLM）混淆的噪声和无关信息。 事实上，DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG 和 DRILS-RAG 在各平均指标上取得了非常相近的结果，F1 分数和精确率的差异小于一个百分点，召回率的差异小于两个百分点（F1 分数分别为 77.6% 和 78.1%，召回率分别为 80.1% 和 81.9%，精确率分别为 76.5% 和 75.8%）。 这表明，没有 RE-RAG 所提供增强的标准 RAG 对 CIA 任务的影响有限。

paragraphs.en: Effectiveness is highest and most stable when RE-RAG is used, outperforming both alternative settings. It exceeds 90% on two of the three datasets, a level reached only once in the other two settings. On average, DRILS achieves an effectiveness of 89.6%, compared with 84.1% for DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG and 85.8% for DRILS-RAG . In terms of cost, DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG is the cheapest, although the difference is relatively small. These results indicate that while incorporating RAG (chunk-based or RE-RAG) improves effectiveness, it also requires more cost. The increase in effectiveness may result from the additional context provided by RAG, which helps identify a broader set of potentially impacted requirements and thus contributes to a more complete impact set. However, retrieving a broader set of requirements also increases the proportion of requirements that must be manually validated, resulting in higher cost.

paragraphs.en: As Table 3 shows, the robustness results vary across settings. The average deviation is 0.07, 0.05, and 0.02 for DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG , DRILS-RAG , and DRILS , respectively. In fact, DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG shows relatively high variability, exceeding 0.05 on 11 out of 15 dataset-metric combinations, with a maximum deviation of 0.14 for precision on D1. DRILS-RAG exceeds this threshold in 6 instances, with a maximum deviation of 0.16 for cost on D3. In contrast, the deviation of DRILS is equal to or below 0.05 for all dataset-metric combinations. These results suggest that incorporating additional context through RAG can reduce the variability across runs. This may be because the additional context gives agents information that effectively guides their responses. This is more pronounced when the context is precisely tailored to the change request, as in RE-RAG. By providing only relevant contextual information, RE-RAG may reduce noise, thereby leading to more consistent results across runs.
paragraphs.zh: 如表3所示，鲁棒性结果在不同设置下有所差异。 DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG、DRILS-RAG 和 DRILS 的平均偏差分别为0.07、0.05和0.02。 事实上，DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG 表现出相对较高的变异性，在15个数据集-指标组合中有11个超过0.05，其中 D1 上精确率的最大偏差为0.14。 DRILS-RAG 有6个实例超过该阈值，其中 D3 上成本的最大偏差为0.16。 相比之下，DRILS 在所有数据集-指标组合上的偏差均等于或低于0.05。 这些结果表明，通过 RAG 引入额外的上下文可以降低多次运行之间的变异性。 这可能是因为额外的上下文为智能体提供了能有效引导其回答的信息。 当上下文精确贴合变更请求时（如 RE-RAG），这一效果更为明显。 通过仅提供相关的上下文信息，RE-RAG 可以减少噪声，从而使多次运行的结果更加一致。

paragraphs.en: To assess whether the performance difference stems from the Generator Agents or the Judge Agent , we analyze the Generator Agents ’ performance and compare it to the overall performance. Table 4 presents the precision, recall, and F 1 F_{1} score for each Generator Agent , as well as for their union, for all settings and datasets. As the table shows, the average F 1 F_{1} score for DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG is 37.1% for Agent1, 47.5% for Agent2, and 33.8% for the union, while for DRILS-RAG , it is 35.0% for Agent1, 44.3% for Agent2, and 33.1% for the union. Finally, DRILS , averages 31.3% for Agent1, 56.2% for Agent2, and 33.4% for the union. DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG has the highest F 1 F_{1} score for Agent1 and the union, while DRILS has the highest average F 1 F_{1} score for Agent2. The low F 1 F_{1} scores are due to low precision, which ranged from 18.0% to 46.0% for individual agents and from 17.0% to 22.9% for the union. These precision scores are extremely low, given that we did not instruct the agents to be as inclusive as possible. The high number of false positives can introduce noise and potentially confuse the Judge Agent , while increasing its filtering workload. Nevertheless, because the Generator Agents are followed by a Judge Agent that filters, this low precision does not harm the overall architecture. Overall, the Generator Agents are not precise in their selection, leaving the Judge Agent to filter false-positive candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估性能差异是源于生成智能体还是评审智能体，我们分析了生成智能体的性能，并将其与整体性能进行比较。 表4展示了所有设置和数据集下每个生成智能体以及它们的并集的精确率、召回率和F 1 F_{1}分数。 如表所示，DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG的Agent1平均F 1 F_{1}分数为37.1%，Agent2为47.5%，并集为33.8%；而DRILS-RAG的Agent1为35.0%，Agent2为44.3%，并集为33.1%。 最后，DRILS的Agent1平均为31.3%，Agent2为56.2%，并集为33.4%。 DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG在Agent1和并集上具有最高的F 1 F_{1}分数，而DRILS在Agent2上具有最高的平均F 1 F_{1}分数。 较低的F 1 F_{1}分数源于较低的精确率，各个智能体的精确率在18.0%至46.0%之间，并集的精确率在17.0%至22.9%之间。 鉴于我们并未指示智能体尽可能保持包容性，这些精确率分数是极低的。 大量的假阳性会引入噪声，并可能使评审智能体产生混淆，同时增加其过滤工作量。 尽管如此，由于生成智能体之后跟着一个进行过滤的评审智能体，这种低精确率并不会损害整体架构。 总体而言，生成智能体的选择并不精确，从而将过滤假阳性候选的任务留给了评审智能体。

paragraphs.en: Regarding recall, the Generator Agents generally achieve high recall across settings and datasets. For DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG , it averaged 88.8% for Agent1, 93.1% for Agent2, and 94.5% for the union, while for DRILS-RAG , it averaged 86.9% for Agent1, 87.1% for Agent2, and 94.5% for the union, and for for DRILS , it averaged 76.2% for Agent1, 86.6% for Agent2, and 91.0% for the union. DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG achieves the highest average recall for Agent1, Agent2, and the union. In fact, DRILS has the lowest average recall across all three settings, possibly because it retrieves fewer requirements than the other two settings. These results suggest that the additional contextual information provided by RE-RAG makes the Generator Agents more selective in identifying potentially impacted requirements. Without RE-RAG, the agents rely primarily on the requirements’ text alone and may identify a broader set of potentially related requirements, resulting in higher recall.
paragraphs.zh: 在召回率方面，生成器智能体在各种设置和数据集上通常都能达到较高的召回率。 对于 DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG，Agent1 平均召回率为 88.8%，Agent2 为 93.1%，并集为 94.5%；对于 DRILS-RAG，Agent1 平均召回率为 86.9%，Agent2 为 87.1%，并集为 94.5%；而对于 DRILS，Agent1 平均召回率为 76.2%，Agent2 为 86.6%，并集为 91.0%。 DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG 在 Agent1、Agent2 和并集上均取得了最高的平均召回率。 事实上，DRILS 在所有三种设置中的平均召回率最低，可能是因为它检索到的需求比其他两种设置更少。 这些结果表明，RE-RAG 提供的额外上下文信息使生成器智能体在识别潜在受影响需求时更具选择性。 在没有 RE-RAG 的情况下，智能体主要仅依赖需求文本，可能会识别出更广泛的潜在相关需求集合，从而获得更高的召回率。

sents.zh: 在召回率方面，生成器智能体在各种设置和数据集上通常都能达到较高的召回率。

sents.zh: 这些结果表明，RE-RAG 提供的额外上下文信息使生成器智能体在识别潜在受影响需求时更具选择性。

sents.en: Without RE-RAG, the agents rely primarily on the requirements’ text alone and may identify a broader set of potentially related requirements, resulting in higher recall.
sents.zh: 在没有 RE-RAG 的情况下，智能体主要仅依赖需求文本，可能会识别出更广泛的潜在相关需求集合，从而获得更高的召回率。

paragraphs.en: In our context, recall of the union is particularly important, as the Judge Agent can select only impacted requirements from the candidates provided by the Generator Agents . Thus, it is necessary to ensure that the Judge Agent is provided with as many potentially impacted requirements as possible. In this regard, DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG achieves the highest union recall and is therefore considered the best-performing setting for the Generator Agents . However, the recall differences between each individual agent and their union are 21 percentage points for DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG , 44.9 percentage points for DRILS-RAG , and 57.5 percentage points for DRILS across datasets. A larger difference suggests that the agents identify more diverse sets of requirements. Thus, for DRILS , the agents identify more diverse sets of requirements, resulting in broad collective coverage despite lower individual recall than in the other settings. This also suggests that the agents in the other settings tend to identify a larger number of the same true-positive requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的场景中，并集的召回率尤为重要，因为评判智能体只能从生成智能体所提供的候选中选择受影响的需求。 因此，有必要确保为评判智能体提供尽可能多的潜在受影响需求。 在这方面，DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG 实现了最高的并集召回率，因此被认为是生成智能体表现最好的设置。 然而，在各数据集上，每个智能体单独的召回率与其并集召回率之间的差异，DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG 为 21 个百分点，DRILS-RAG 为 44.9 个百分点，DRILS 为 57.5 个百分点。 差异越大，说明各智能体识别出的需求集合越多样。 因此，对于 DRILS，各智能体识别出的需求集合更加多样，尽管单个智能体的召回率低于其他设置，但仍实现了广泛的集体覆盖。 这也表明其他设置中的智能体倾向于识别出更多相同的真阳性需求。

paragraphs.en: When comparing the union recall of the agents with that of the Judge Agent , a different pattern emerges. Although DRILS achieved the lowest average union recall for the Generator Agents , it achieved the highest overall average recall. The average recall dropped only from 91.0% to 87.1% (a 3.9 percentage point drop), compared with DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG , which dropped from 94.5% to 80.0% (a 14.5 percentage point drop). Thus, although removing RAG improved the performance of the Generator Agents , both individually and in union, it reduced final recall. This may be due to the lower quality of the auxiliary information than in DRILS . Because the Generator Agents lack domain context, their rationale may be less accurate and therefore less useful to the Judge Agent . In contrast, for DRILS , although the Generator Agents identified fewer true positives, the Judge Agent correctly identified more impacted requirements from that pool, likely due to the more grounded auxiliary information. Also, for DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG , the overall recall is lower than that of Agent2 (the best-performing agent) for all three datasets. This suggests that the Judge Agent does not rely more on the predictions of the best-performing Generator Agent . This might be because Agent2 has a lower average confidence score for true positives than Agent1 (e.g., 4.62 vs. 4.95 for D1, and 4.34 vs. 4.71 for D3), suggesting Agent2 is less confident in its decisions and thus less influential in the Judge’s decision. In contrast, for DRILS , the overall recall is higher than that of Agent2 for two out of the three datasets. While it does not indicate that the Judge took all the responses given by Agent2 into consideration, it suggests that the Judge was able to make more effective use of the Generator Agents ’ outputs compared to DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG .
paragraphs.zh: 当将各智能体的并集召回率与裁判智能体的并集召回率进行比较时，出现了不同的模式。 尽管 DRILS 在生成器智能体中的平均并集召回率最低，但它获得了最高的整体平均召回率。 平均召回率仅从 91.0% 下降到 87.1%（下降了 3.9 个百分点），而 DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG 则从 94.5% 下降到 80.0%（下降了 14.5 个百分点）。 因此，尽管移除 RAG 提升了生成器智能体在个体层面和并集层面的表现，但它降低了最终召回率。 这可能是由于辅助信息的质量低于 DRILS 中的辅助信息。 由于生成器智能体缺乏领域背景，其推理可能不够准确，因而对裁判智能体的作用较小。 相比之下，对于 DRILS，尽管生成器智能体识别出的真阳性较少，但裁判智能体从该候选池中正确识别出了更多受影响的需求，这可能是由于辅助信息更有依据。 此外，对于 DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG，其整体召回率在全部三个数据集上都低于 Agent2（表现最好的智能体）。 这表明裁判智能体并没有更多依赖表现最好的生成器智能体的预测结果。 这可能是因为 Agent2 对真阳性的平均置信度得分低于 Agent1（例如，在 D1 上为 4.62 对 4.95，在 D3 上为 4.34 对 4.71），这表明 Agent2 对其决策的信心较低，因而对裁判决策的影响较小。 相比之下，对于 DRILS，其整体召回率在三个数据集中的两个上高于 Agent2。 虽然这并不表明裁判考虑了 Agent2 给出的所有回复，但与 DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG 相比，这表明裁判能够更有效地利用生成器智能体的输出。

sents.en: When comparing the union recall of the agents with that of the Judge Agent , a different pattern emerges.
sents.zh: 当将各智能体的并集召回率与裁判智能体的并集召回率进行比较时，出现了不同的模式。

sents.en: Although DRILS achieved the lowest average union recall for the Generator Agents , it achieved the highest overall average recall.
sents.zh: 尽管 DRILS 在生成器智能体中的平均并集召回率最低，但它获得了最高的整体平均召回率。

sents.en: The average recall dropped only from 91.0% to 87.1% (a 3.9 percentage point drop), compared with DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG , which dropped from 94.5% to 80.0% (a 14.5 percentage point drop).
sents.zh: 平均召回率仅从 91.0% 下降到 87.1%（下降了 3.9 个百分点），而 DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG 则从 94.5% 下降到 80.0%（下降了 14.5 个百分点）。

sents.en: Thus, although removing RAG improved the performance of the Generator Agents , both individually and in union, it reduced final recall.
sents.zh: 因此，尽管移除 RAG 提升了生成器智能体在个体层面和并集层面的表现，但它降低了最终召回率。

sents.en: This may be due to the lower quality of the auxiliary information than in DRILS .
sents.zh: 这可能是由于辅助信息的质量低于 DRILS 中的辅助信息。

sents.en: Because the Generator Agents lack domain context, their rationale may be less accurate and therefore less useful to the Judge Agent .
sents.zh: 由于生成器智能体缺乏领域背景，其推理可能不够准确，因而对裁判智能体的作用较小。

sents.en: In contrast, for DRILS , although the Generator Agents identified fewer true positives, the Judge Agent correctly identified more impacted requirements from that pool, likely due to the more grounded auxiliary information.
sents.zh: 相比之下，对于 DRILS，尽管生成器智能体识别出的真阳性较少，但裁判智能体从该候选池中正确识别出了更多受影响的需求，这可能是由于辅助信息更有依据。

sents.en: Also, for DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG , the overall recall is lower than that of Agent2 (the best-performing agent) for all three datasets.
sents.zh: 此外，对于 DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG，其整体召回率在全部三个数据集上都低于 Agent2（表现最好的智能体）。

sents.en: This suggests that the Judge Agent does not rely more on the predictions of the best-performing Generator Agent .
sents.zh: 这表明裁判智能体并没有更多依赖表现最好的生成器智能体的预测结果。

sents.en: This might be because Agent2 has a lower average confidence score for true positives than Agent1 (e.g., 4.62 vs. 4.95 for D1, and 4.34 vs. 4.71 for D3), suggesting Agent2 is less confident in its decisions and thus less influential in the Judge’s decision.
sents.zh: 这可能是因为 Agent2 对真阳性的平均置信度得分低于 Agent1（例如，在 D1 上为 4.62 对 4.95，在 D3 上为 4.34 对 4.71），这表明 Agent2 对其决策的信心较低，因而对裁判决策的影响较小。

sents.en: In contrast, for DRILS , the overall recall is higher than that of Agent2 for two out of the three datasets.
sents.zh: 相比之下，对于 DRILS，其整体召回率在三个数据集中的两个上高于 Agent2。

sents.en: While it does not indicate that the Judge took all the responses given by Agent2 into consideration, it suggests that the Judge was able to make more effective use of the Generator Agents ’ outputs compared to DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG .
sents.zh: 虽然这并不表明裁判考虑了 Agent2 给出的所有回复，但与 DRILS-w/o-RE-RAG 相比，这表明裁判能够更有效地利用生成器智能体的输出。

paragraphs.en: A common pattern across all these settings is that Agent2 performs significantly better than Agent1 for the task. This is reflected in consistently higher precision and recall across almost all configurations, indicating that Agent2 (Claude) is more effective for the task. This difference is particularly pronounced for DRILS , which achieved the lowest average F 1 F_{1} score for Agent1 and the highest average F 1 F_{1} score for Agent2. This difference may be attributed to the different capabilities of the agents in analyzing and leveraging the enriched contextual information provided by RE-RAG.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有这些设置中，一个共同的模式是智能体2在该任务上的表现明显优于智能体1。 这体现在几乎所有配置中智能体2都具有持续更高的精确率和召回率，表明智能体2（Claude）在该任务上更为有效。 这一差异在 DRILS 上尤为显著，其在智能体1下取得了最低的平均 F 1 F_{1} 分数，而在智能体2下取得了最高的平均 F 1 F_{1} 分数。 这一差异可能归因于两个智能体在分析和利用 RE-RAG 所提供的丰富上下文信息方面的能力不同。

sents.zh: 在所有这些设置中，一个共同的模式是智能体2在该任务上的表现明显优于智能体1。

sents.en: This difference may be attributed to the different capabilities of the agents in analyzing and leveraging the enriched contextual information provided by RE-RAG.
sents.zh: 这一差异可能归因于两个智能体在分析和利用 RE-RAG 所提供的丰富上下文信息方面的能力不同。

paragraphs.en: Overall, while excluding RE-RAG generally resulted in higher recall for the Generator Agents , including it provided a higher overall output recall. These results indicate that RE-RAG has mainly affected the Judge Agent ’s decision-making rather than the Generator Agents ’ impact set identification. This may be due to the superior quality of the auxiliary information, as it provides more relevant and focused domain context.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，虽然排除 RE-RAG 通常会使生成智能体获得更高的召回率，但将其纳入则提供了更高的整体输出召回率。 这些结果表明，RE-RAG 主要影响的是评判智能体的决策，而非生成智能体的影响集识别。 这可能是由于辅助信息的质量更高，因为它提供了更相关、更集中的领域上下文。

sents.en: Overall, while excluding RE-RAG generally resulted in higher recall for the Generator Agents , including it provided a higher overall output recall.
sents.zh: 总体而言，虽然排除 RE-RAG 通常会使生成智能体获得更高的召回率，但将其纳入则提供了更高的整体输出召回率。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we analyze the results of two alternative techniques to the clustering step within DRILS : (1) DRILS-w/o-Cluster where all requirements are provided at once and no technique is applied to divide the requirements list before providing it to the Generator Agents , and (2) DRILS-Batch , where the requirements list is divided into fixed-size batches. For the latter, we split each dataset’s requirements list into two batches. This batch size was chosen to minimize the cost of API calls for both the GPT and Claude models. In DRILS , the Generator Agents processed each cluster individually, which corresponds to three, two, and three clusters for D1, D2, and D3, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们分析 DRILS 中聚类步骤的两种替代技术的结果：(1) DRILS-w/o-Cluster，即一次性提供所有需求，并且在将需求列表提供给生成智能体之前不使用任何技术对其进行划分；(2) DRILS-Batch，即将需求列表划分为固定大小的批次。 对于后者，我们将每个数据集的需求列表划分为两个批次。 选择这一批次大小是为了最小化 GPT 和 Claude 模型的 API 调用成本。 在 DRILS 中，生成智能体逐个处理每个聚类，这分别对应于 D1、D2 和 D3 的三个、两个和三个聚类。

sents.en: In this section, we analyze the results of two alternative techniques to the clustering step within DRILS : (1) DRILS-w/o-Cluster where all requirements are provided at once and no technique is applied to divide the requirements list before providing it to the Generator Agents , and (2) DRILS-Batch , where the requirements list is divided into fixed-size batches.

sents.en: For the latter, we split each dataset’s requirements list into two batches.
sents.zh: 对于后者，我们将每个数据集的需求列表划分为两个批次。

sents.en: This batch size was chosen to minimize the cost of API calls for both the GPT and Claude models.
sents.zh: 选择这一批次大小是为了最小化 GPT 和 Claude 模型的 API 调用成本。

sents.en: In DRILS , the Generator Agents processed each cluster individually, which corresponds to three, two, and three clusters for D1, D2, and D3, respectively.
sents.zh: 在 DRILS 中，生成智能体逐个处理每个聚类，这分别对应于 D1、D2 和 D3 的三个、两个和三个聚类。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 presents results for these two settings alongside DRILS . For F 1 F_{1} score, no setting is clearly superior, as each achieves the highest score on one dataset: DRILS-Batch on D1, DRILS-w/o-Cluster on D2, and DRILS on D3. The higher F 1 F_{1} scores of DRILS-w/o-cluster and DRILS-Batch compared with DRILS are driven by their higher precision. The average precision reached 83.3%, 79.7%, and 76.3% for DRILS-w/o-Cluster , DRILS-Batch , and DRILS , respectively. The higher precision when the requirements list is not divided may be due to the broader context it provides to the Generator Agents , which may help them better distinguish between impacted and non-impacted requirements. This effect is particularly pronounced for D2, where DRILS-w/o-Cluster achieves the highest performance across all metrics. However, D2 has fewer requirements than APA and ADB, which likely explains this behavior. When the total number of requirements is small, providing them all in a single prompt gives the model complete context without encountering the lost-in-the-middle problem ( Liu et al., 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: In contrast, dividing the requirements list provides an advantage in terms of recall. DRILS achieves the highest average recall of 87.1%, compared with 82.3% for DRILS-w/o-Cluster and 84%. This indicates that dividing the requirements list allows the identification of more potentially impacted requirements. This may be because splitting a large requirements list into smaller sets reduces the information the Generator Agents must process simultaneously, allowing them to focus more effectively on the requirements relevant to the change request. This is particularly important for safety-critical systems, where the number of requirements can be substantially larger than the evaluated datasets. In this case, injecting all requirements into a single prompt becomes impractical and non-scalable. When comparing DRILS-Batch with DRILS , DRILS achieves higher recall at the cost of a marginal decrease in precision, making it the more suitable choice for the CIA task. This may be because clustering divides requirements more effectively by grouping similar and related requirements into the same cluster, giving the Generator Agents more relevant context than simple size-based batching.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，对需求列表进行划分在召回率方面提供了优势。 DRILS 实现了最高的平均召回率 87.1%，相比之下 DRILS-w/o-Cluster 为 82.3%，另一方法为 84%。 这表明对需求列表进行划分能够识别出更多潜在受影响的需求。 这可能是因为将一个大的需求列表拆分为较小的集合，减少了生成智能体需要同时处理的信息量，使其能够更有效地聚焦于与变更请求相关的需求。 这对于安全关键系统尤为重要，因为此类系统的需求数量可能远大于所评估的数据集。 在这种情况下，将所有需求注入单个提示词变得不切实际且不可扩展。 在比较 DRILS-Batch 与 DRILS 时，DRILS 以精度上的边际下降为代价获得了更高的召回率，使其成为 CIA 任务更合适的选择。 这可能是因为聚类通过将相似和相关需求归入同一簇，比基于规模的简单批处理更有效地划分了需求，为生成智能体提供了更相关的上下文。

paragraphs.en: Regarding effectiveness, DRILS achieves higher average effectiveness than the other two settings, surpassing 90% on two of the three datasets. In terms of cost, DRILS-w/o-Cluster has the lowest cost, followed by DRILS-Batch and DRILS . These results indicate that while clustering achieves the highest effectiveness, it also incurs the highest cost, likely because it retrieves larger impact sets for validation, requiring the requirements analyst to review a greater proportion of requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 在有效性方面，DRILS 取得了比另外两种设置更高的平均有效性，在三个数据集中的两个上超过了 90%。 在成本方面，DRILS-w/o-Cluster 的成本最低，其次是 DRILS-Batch 和 DRILS。 这些结果表明，虽然聚类取得了最高的有效性，但也带来了最高的成本，这很可能是因为它检索到更大的影响集用于验证，需要需求分析师审查更大比例的需求。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the results are robust, with an average deviation of 0.033 across the three settings. Specifically, the average deviation is 0.038 for DRILS-w/o-cluster , 0.037 for DRILS-Batch , and 0.026 for DRILS . These results indicate that dividing the requirements list, particularly through a similarity-based strategy rather than fixed-size batching, reduces result variability across runs. This may be because the Generator Agents need to process less information simultaneously, allowing them to focus on a smaller, more coherent subset of requirements.

paragraphs.en: Table 6 presents the performance metrics for each Generator Agent and their union across the three settings and datasets. The average F 1 F_{1} scores for Agent1, Agent2, and their union for DRILS-w/o-Cluster are 49.9%, 65.7%, and 52.5%, respectively. For DRILS-Batch , the corresponding average F 1 F_{1} scores are 40.5%, 59.3%, and 45.3%, while for DRILS , they reach 31.3%, 56.2%, and 33.4%, respectively. These results indicate that DRILS-w/o-Cluster is the best setting for the Generator Agents , both individually and in union, possibly because they are provided with a broader context. However, because processing all requirements simultaneously can be impractical in real-world scenarios with large requirements specifications, particularly for safety-critical systems, it is important to identify which of the two grouping techniques, batching or clustering, is more effective for the Generator Agents .

paragraphs.en: Compared with DRILS , DRILS-Batch achieves higher average F 1 F_{1} scores. This is mainly due to its higher precision, which averages 34.2% compared with 27.0% for DRILS . In contrast, recall is marginally higher for DRILS , averaging 84.6% compared with 83.6% for DRILS-Batch . This difference is mainly attributable to DRILS ’ superior performance for Agent1 on two of the three datasets. However, DRILS-Batch achieves marginally higher union recall (92.5% versus 91.0%). Since union recall is particularly important for our evaluation, as the goal of Impact-set Identification is to provide the Judge Agent with a complete set of impacted requirements, we consider DRILS-Batch the most effective technique for dividing the requirements list at the Generator Agent level.

paragraphs.en: While a high union recall indicates strong candidate coverage by the Generator Agents , it does not guarantee that all impacted requirements will be retained in the Judge Agent ’s final output. This is evident in Table 5 , where DRILS achieves a higher average recall than both DRILS-w/o-Cluster and DRILS-Batch , even though the latter two settings retrieve a larger number of candidate requirements at the Generator Agents stage. To investigate the reasons underlying this difference, we examine the average confidence scores assigned to True Positive (TP) and False Positive (FP) requirements across settings. The average confidence scores for TPs and FPs are 4.68 and 4.02 for DRILS-w/o-Cluster , 4.69 and 3.86 for DRILS-Batch , and 4.73 and 3.60 for DRILS , respectively. These results indicate that DRILS assigns the highest confidence scores to TPs and the lowest to FPs, suggesting that the Generator Agents assign higher confidence to truly impacted requirements while being more cautious about false positives. In contrast, DRILS-w/o-Cluster and DRILS-Batch show a smaller difference, mainly because their FP confidence scores are higher. This smaller margin may hinder the Judge Agent ’s ability to distinguish between truly impacted and non-impacted requirements, which can explain the low recall for these two settings.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然较高的联合召回率表明生成智能体具有强大的候选需求覆盖能力，但这并不能保证所有受影响的需求都会保留在评审智能体的最终输出中。 表 5 清楚地体现了这一点：尽管 DRILS-w/o-Cluster 和 DRILS-Batch 在生成智能体阶段检索到更多数量的候选需求，但 DRILS 取得了比两者更高的平均召回率。 为探究造成这一差异的原因，我们考察了各设置下分配给真阳性（TP）和假阳性（FP）需求的平均置信度分数。 DRILS-w/o-Cluster 的 TP 和 FP 平均置信度分数分别为 4.68 和 4.02，DRILS-Batch 分别为 4.69 和 3.86，DRILS 分别为 4.73 和 3.60。 这些结果表明，DRILS 给 TP 分配了最高的置信度分数，给 FP 分配了最低的置信度分数，这说明生成智能体对真正受影响的需求赋予更高的置信度，同时对假阳性更加谨慎。 相比之下，DRILS-w/o-Cluster 和 DRILS-Batch 的差距较小，主要原因是它们的 FP 置信度分数较高。 这一较小的差距可能削弱评审智能体区分真正受影响与不受影响需求的能力，这可以解释这两种设置召回率较低的原因。

paragraphs.en: When comparing agents, Agent2 outperforms Agent1 across almost all settings and datasets, achieving higher average F 1 F_{1} score, recall, and precision. This consistent improvement indicates that Agent2 performs better overall on the CIA task. Moreover, Agent2’s performance appears to be less affected by the number of input requirements. This is reflected in the smaller difference between the F 1 F_{1} score of DRILS-w/o-Cluster , which processes all requirements simultaneously, and those of DRILS-Batch and DRILS , which process smaller groups of requirements. Specifically, when comparing the F 1 F_{1} score of DRILS-w/o-Cluster with the minimum F 1 F_{1} score between DRILS-Batch and DRILS , Agent1 exhibits differences of 15.9, 22.2, and 17.0 percentage points across D1, D2, and D3, respectively. In contrast, Agent2’s corresponding differences are much smaller, at 4.4, 16.6, and 14.8 percentage points, suggesting that Agent2 is comparatively less sensitive to changes in the number of input requirements.

paragraphs.en: Overall, while providing the entire requirements list resulted in higher performance across all metrics for the Generator Agents , clustering requirements yielded higher overall output recall. These results suggest that clustering primarily affects the Judge Agent ’s decision-making process rather than the Generator Agents ’ identification of impact sets. This may be because the Generator Agents assign more meaningful confidence scores, thereby better guiding the Judge Agent ’s decisions
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，虽然提供完整的需求列表使生成智能体在所有指标上均获得更高性能，但对需求进行聚类带来了更高的整体输出召回率。 这些结果表明，聚类主要影响裁判智能体的决策过程，而非生成智能体对影响集的识别。 这可能是因为生成智能体给出了更有意义的置信度分数，从而更好地引导裁判智能体的决策。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 presents the results of DRILS-w/o-RDG and DRILS . Overall, DRILS outperforms DRILS-w/o-RDG on almost all metrics across all datasets. The average F 1 F_{1} score increased from 76.7% for DRILS-w/o-RDG to 81% for DRILS , with DRILS achieving F 1 F_{1} scores above 80% on two of the three datasets, whereas DRILS-w/o-RDG remains below 80% on all three datasets. The difference is more pronounced for recall, which increases from an average of 81.2% for DRILS-w/o-RDG to 87.1% for DRILS . Precision also improves when we incorporate the RDG, although the difference is less pronounced, with increases of 1.6 and 0.8 percentage points on D1 and D3, respectively. These results indicate that removing the dependency graph consistently reduces F 1 F_{1} score, precision, and recall, suggesting that the dependency graph plays a critical role in directing the Generator Agents to identify impacted requirements both more completely and more precisely. This may be because the RDG explicitly defines links between requirements, helping the agents identify additional requirements that may be impacted when a related requirement is considered impacted. This information is only explicitly defined in an RDG, making it a valuable input to DRILS .
paragraphs.zh: 表7展示了DRILS-w/o-RDG与DRILS的结果。 总体而言，DRILS在所有数据集上的几乎所有指标上都优于DRILS-w/o-RDG。 平均F 1 F_{1}分数从DRILS-w/o-RDG的76.7%提升至DRILS的81%，其中DRILS在三个数据集中的两个上F 1 F_{1}分数超过80%，而DRILS-w/o-RDG在全部三个数据集上均低于80%。 这一差异在召回率上更为明显，召回率从DRILS-w/o-RDG的平均81.2%提升至DRILS的87.1%。 引入RDG后精确率也有所提升，尽管差异不那么显著，在D1和D3上分别提升了1.6和0.8个百分点。 这些结果表明，移除依赖关系图会持续降低F 1 F_{1}分数、精确率和召回率，说明依赖关系图在引导智能体更完整、更精确地识别受影响需求方面起着关键作用。 这可能是因为RDG明确定义了需求之间的关联，帮助智能体识别当某一相关需求被视为受影响时可能受到影响的其余需求。 这些信息只在RDG中被明确定义，使其成为DRILS的宝贵输入。

sents.en: Overall, DRILS outperforms DRILS-w/o-RDG on almost all metrics across all datasets.
sents.zh: 总体而言，DRILS在所有数据集上的几乎所有指标上都优于DRILS-w/o-RDG。

sents.en: The average F 1 F_{1} score increased from 76.7% for DRILS-w/o-RDG to 81% for DRILS , with DRILS achieving F 1 F_{1} scores above 80% on two of the three datasets, whereas DRILS-w/o-RDG remains below 80% on all three datasets.
sents.zh: 平均F 1 F_{1}分数从DRILS-w/o-RDG的76.7%提升至DRILS的81%，其中DRILS在三个数据集中的两个上F 1 F_{1}分数超过80%，而DRILS-w/o-RDG在全部三个数据集上均低于80%。

sents.en: The difference is more pronounced for recall, which increases from an average of 81.2% for DRILS-w/o-RDG to 87.1% for DRILS .
sents.zh: 这一差异在召回率上更为明显，召回率从DRILS-w/o-RDG的平均81.2%提升至DRILS的87.1%。

sents.en: Precision also improves when we incorporate the RDG, although the difference is less pronounced, with increases of 1.6 and 0.8 percentage points on D1 and D3, respectively.
sents.zh: 引入RDG后精确率也有所提升，尽管差异不那么显著，在D1和D3上分别提升了1.6和0.8个百分点。

sents.en: These results indicate that removing the dependency graph consistently reduces F 1 F_{1} score, precision, and recall, suggesting that the dependency graph plays a critical role in directing the Generator Agents to identify impacted requirements both more completely and more precisely.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，移除依赖关系图会持续降低F 1 F_{1}分数、精确率和召回率，说明依赖关系图在引导智能体更完整、更精确地识别受影响需求方面起着关键作用。

sents.en: This may be because the RDG explicitly defines links between requirements, helping the agents identify additional requirements that may be impacted when a related requirement is considered impacted.
sents.zh: 这可能是因为RDG明确定义了需求之间的关联，帮助智能体识别当某一相关需求被视为受影响时可能受到影响的其余需求。

sents.en: This information is only explicitly defined in an RDG, making it a valuable input to DRILS .
sents.zh: 这些信息只在RDG中被明确定义，使其成为DRILS的宝贵输入。

paragraphs.en: Including an RDG also positively impacts effectiveness, with effectiveness scores exceeding 90% on both D1 and D2, a threshold that was not achieved by DRILS-w/o-RDG on either dataset. Regarding cost, DRILS-w/o-RDG achieved the lowest cost on D1 and D3, while costs were equal across both settings on D2. However, DRILS was more robust, with cost deviations always at or below 0.05, compared with DRILS-w/o-RDG , where cost deviations ranged from 0.06 to 0.10. Furthermore, the difference in cost was small across datasets, averaging 5.8% for DRILS-w/o-RDG and 6.0% for DRILS , a difference of only 0.2 percentage points. Therefore, incorporating an RDG improves effectiveness while keeping costs similar to DRILS-w/o-RDG . Overall, given the consistent improvements across metrics, we consider RDG a valuable input for DRILS .
paragraphs.zh: 加入 RDG 还能对有效性产生积极影响，在 D1 和 D2 上的有效性得分均超过 90%，而 DRILS-w/o-RDG 在两个数据集上都未能达到这一阈值。 在成本方面，DRILS-w/o-RDG 在 D1 和 D3 上取得了最低成本，而在 D2 上两种设置的成本相同。 然而，DRILS 更加稳健，其成本偏差始终处于 0.05 或以下，而 DRILS-w/o-RDG 的成本偏差在 0.06 到 0.10 之间。 此外，各数据集之间的成本差异很小，DRILS-w/o-RDG 平均为 5.8%，DRILS 平均为 6.0%，差异仅为 0.2 个百分点。 因此，引入 RDG 在提升有效性的同时，保持了与 DRILS-w/o-RDG 相近的成本。 总体而言，鉴于各项指标上的一致改进，我们认为 RDG 是 DRILS 的一个有价值的输入。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the results are robust, with an average deviation of 0.038 across both settings. The deviation for DRILS-w/o-RDG averages 0.05 compared with 0.026 for DRILS . This reinforces the pattern observed in RQ2: providing additional context, in this case through an RDG, reduces variability across runs by giving the Generator Agents more information to guide their responses. These results further highlight the importance of incorporating an RDG into the DRILS architecture.

paragraphs.en: Table 8 presents the performance metrics for each Generator Agent , along with their union across all settings and datasets. The average F 1 F_{1} scores for DRILS-w/o-RDG are 34.1% for Agent1, 51.3% for Agent2, and 35.0% for the union, while for DRILS , they reach 31.3%, 56.2%, and 33.4%, respectively. These results indicate that excluding the RDG yields higher F 1 F_{1} scores for Agent1 and the union, while including it yields higher F 1 F_{1} scores for Agent2. Notably, DRILS-w/o-RDG achieves higher F 1 F_{1} scores for Agent1 and the union because it performs better on D1 and D3. In contrast, DRILS achieves the highest F 1 F_{1} scores for Agent1, Agent2, and the union on D2. This may be because D2 has the fewest dependencies in its RDG (29), compared with 53 for D1 and 81 for D3, so including the RDG has less impact and yields results more similar to those without it. However, the differences in average F 1 F_{1} score between the two settings are relatively small, with 2.8 percentage points in favor of DRILS-w/o-RDG for Agent1, 4.9 percentage points in favor of DRILS for Agent2, and 1.6 percentage points in favor of DRILS-w/o-RDG for the union. Thus, since neither setting consistently outperforms the other and the differences in average F 1 F_{1} score are relatively small, we need to examine other metrics more closely to identify the superior setting for the Generator Agents .
paragraphs.zh: 表8展示了每个生成器智能体的性能指标，以及它们在所有设置和数据集上的并集结果。 DRILS-w/o-RDG 在 Agent1、Agent2 和并集上的平均 F_{1} 分数分别为 34.1%、51.3% 和 35.0%，而 DRILS 则分别达到 31.3%、56.2% 和 33.4%。 这些结果表明，排除 RDG 时 Agent1 和并集获得更高的 F_{1} 分数，而包含 RDG 时 Agent2 获得更高的 F_{1} 分数。 值得注意的是，DRILS-w/o-RDG 在 Agent1 和并集上取得更高的 F_{1} 分数，是因为它在 D1 和 D3 上表现更好。 相比之下，DRILS 在 D2 上为 Agent1、Agent2 和并集取得了最高的 F_{1} 分数。 这可能是因为 D2 的 RDG 中依赖关系最少（29 个），而 D1 和 D3 分别有 53 个和 81 个，因此包含 RDG 的影响较小，其结果与不包含 RDG 的结果更为相似。 然而，两种设置之间的平均 F_{1} 分数差异相对较小：Agent1 上 DRILS-w/o-RDG 高出 2.8 个百分点，Agent2 上 DRILS 高出 4.9 个百分点，并集上 DRILS-w/o-RDG 高出 1.6 个百分点。 因此，由于两种设置均未持续优于对方，且平均 F_{1} 分数差异相对较小，我们需要更仔细地考察其他指标，以确定生成器智能体的更优设置。

paragraphs.en: For DRILS-w/o-RDG , Agent1 achieves an average recall of 73.6% and an average precision of 22.0%, while Agent2 achieves 87.9% and 36.6%. For DRILS , Agent1 achieves an average recall of 76.2% and an average precision of 19.9%, while Agent2 yields 86.7% and 40.6%. These results suggest that incorporating an RDG affects the two agents differently. For Agent1, it increases recall while reducing precision, suggesting that the agent identifies a broader set of candidate requirements. In contrast, Agent2 achieves higher precision at the cost of a slight decrease in recall, suggesting a more selective impact set identification.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 DRILS-w/o-RDG，智能体1 的平均召回率为 73.6%，平均精确率为 22.0%，而智能体2 的结果分别为 87.9% 和 36.6%。 对于 DRILS，智能体1 的平均召回率为 76.2%，平均精确率为 19.9%，而智能体2 的结果为 86.7% 和 40.6%。 这些结果表明，引入 RDG 对两个智能体的影响不同。 对于智能体1，RDG 提高了召回率但降低了精确率，这表明该智能体识别出了更广泛的候选需求集合。 相比之下，智能体2 以召回率略微下降为代价获得了更高的精确率，这表明其影响集识别更具选择性。

paragraphs.en: Regarding the union, DRILS achieves the highest union recall on all three datasets. This higher union recall suggests that incorporating an RDG helps the Generator Agents produce a more complete set of candidate impacted requirements, providing the Judge Agent with a broader pool of candidates. This improvement may be attributable to the additional context provided by the RDG to the Generator Agents (i.e., the links between requirements and the type of these links), as well as the potentially improved quality of the auxiliary information. One element of this auxiliary information is the confidence score. For DRILS-w/o-RDG , the average confidence score for TPs and FPs is 4.69 and 3.65, respectively, compared with 4.73 and 3.60 for DRILS . This suggests that incorporating the RDG is associated with higher confidence in correctly identified impacted requirements and lower confidence in false-positive predictions, which can help the Judge Agent distinguish between relevant and irrelevant candidates during filtering.
paragraphs.zh: 关于并集，DRILS 在全部三个数据集上都取得了最高的并集召回率。 这一更高的并集召回率表明，引入 RDG 有助于生成器智能体产出更完整的候选受影响需求集合，从而为裁判智能体提供更广泛的候选池。 这一改进可能归因于 RDG 为生成器智能体提供的额外上下文（即需求之间的链接及这些链接的类型），以及辅助信息质量可能得到的提升。 该辅助信息的一项内容是置信度分数。 对于 DRILS-w/o-RDG，真正例和假正例的平均置信度分数分别为 4.69 和 3.65，而 DRILS 则为 4.73 和 3.60。 这表明引入 RDG 与对正确识别的受影响需求具有更高的置信度以及对假正例预测具有更低的置信度相关联，这有助于裁判智能体在过滤过程中区分相关与不相关的候选。

paragraphs.en: When an RDG is included, the Generator Agents produced more diverse and complementary candidate sets. This is reflected in the differences between each agent’s individual recall and their union recall, which reach 57.5 percentage points for DRILS , compared with 53.1 percentage points for DRILS-w/o-RDG . One possible explanation is that incorporating the RDG encourages the Generator Agents to explore different dependency paths when identifying impacted requirements, resulting in more diverse candidate sets, as reflected in DRILS ’s superior union recall. Finally, Consistent with the findings of RQ2, Agent2 outperforms Agent1 in terms of recall, precision, and F 1 F_{1} score across all evaluated settings and datasets, reflecting its stronger overall performance in impact set identification.
paragraphs.zh: 当包含 RDG 时，生成器智能体产生了更多样且互补的候选集。 这体现在每个智能体的个体召回率与其并集召回率之间的差异上：DRILS 的差异达到 57.5 个百分点，而 DRILS-w/o-RDG 为 53.1 个百分点。 一种可能的解释是，引入 RDG 促使生成器智能体在识别受影响需求时探索不同的依赖路径，从而得到更多样的候选集，这体现在 DRILS 更高的并集召回率上。 最后，与 RQ2 的发现一致，在所有评估设置和数据集上，Agent2 在召回率、精确率和 F 1 F_{1} 分数方面都优于 Agent1，反映出其在影响集识别方面更强的整体性能。

paragraphs.en: Overall, incorporating an RDG benefits the Judge Agent during filtering, potentially by improving the quality of the auxiliary information. Combined with the higher union recall observed at the Generator stage, these findings suggest that the RDG can benefit both the identification of candidate impacted requirements by the Generator Agents and the subsequent filtering performed by the Judge Agent.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，引入 RDG 有利于 Judge Agent 进行过滤，可能是因为其提升了辅助信息的质量。 结合在 Generator 阶段观察到的更高并集召回率，这些发现表明，RDG 既能帮助 Generator Agent 识别受影响的候选需求，也有利于 Judge Agent 随后进行的过滤。

paragraphs.en: To address this research question, we compare DRILS against four baselines, which were selected based on the criteria described in Section 3.3 : (1) LSI , an information retrieval approach, (2) SBERT , a pre-trained embedding approach based on a language model, (3) LLM-Vec , a pre-trained embedding approach based on a large language model, and (4) ProReFiCIA , an LLM-based approach. The first three approaches (i.e., LSI , SBERT , and LLM-Vec ) generate textual embeddings of the change rationale and requirements, then identify the impact set by measuring their semantic similarity. For each of these approaches, we apply the two threshold selection strategies ( T 1 T_{1} and T 2 T_{2} ) described in Section 3.3 to derive the final impact set. Thus, our evaluation considers a total of seven baseline variants, six resulting from applying the two threshold selection strategies to each of the three approaches, and one corresponding to ProReFiCIA . Table 9 reports the results for all seven baseline variants, in addition to DRILS , for the three datasets. The highest scores are highlighted in bold. As in the previous RQs, we use recall, precision, F 1 F_{1} score, effectiveness, and cost as evaluation metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答这一研究问题，我们将 DRILS 与四个基线方法进行比较，这些基线是依据 3.3 节所述标准选取的：（1）LSI，一种信息检索方法；（2）SBERT，一种基于语言模型的预训练嵌入方法；（3）LLM-Vec，一种基于大语言模型的预训练嵌入方法；（4）ProReFiCIA，一种基于大语言模型的方法。 前三种方法（即 LSI、SBERT 和 LLM-Vec）生成变更理由与需求的文本嵌入，然后通过度量它们的语义相似度来识别影响集。 对于这些方法中的每一种，我们应用 3.3 节所述的两种阈值选择策略（T 1 T_{1} 和 T 2 T_{2}）来得出最终的影响集。 因此，我们的评估共考虑七种基线变体，其中六种来自对三种方法分别应用两种阈值选择策略，另一种对应 ProReFiCIA。 表 9 报告了全部七种基线变体以及 DRILS 在三个数据集上的结果。 最高分以粗体突出显示。 与前面的研究问题一样，我们使用召回率、精确率、F 1 F_{1} 分数、有效性和成本作为评估指标。

paragraphs.en: For LSI , SBERT , and LLM-Vec , we experimented with two threshold selection strategies. For LSI , T 1 T_{1} achieves a superior F 1 F_{1} score for two out of three datasets. However, the average F 1 F_{1} score is similar between the two strategies, reaching 31.7% for T 1 T_{1} compared to 31.6% for T 1 T_{1} . For SBERT and LLM-Vec , T 1 T_{1} yields a superior F 1 F_{1} score on two and three of the three datasets, respectively. Moreover, T 2 T_{2} achieves average F 1 F_{1} scores of 27.7% and 25.1% for SBERT and LLM-Vec , respectively, compared to 19.1% and 16.3% for T 1 T_{1} . Although the differences in F 1 F_{1} scores are relatively marginal, T 1 T_{1} provides substantially higher recall for almost all experiments. For LSI, the average recall increases from 39.8% to 84.8%, while for SBERT and LLM-Vec , it increases from 59.3% to 86.5% and from 62.1% to 81.5%, respectively. This corresponds to relative gains of 113.1%, 45.9%, and 31.2%, respectively. This substantial difference in recall can be attributed to setting T 2 T_{2} below the average of the higher scores, which generally lowers the threshold and thus includes more requirements in the predicted impact set, increasing the chance of capturing true positives. Nonetheless, the F 1 F_{1} score for each approach remains below 50%, indicating that semantic similarity alone is insufficient to accurately identify the impact set.
