paragraphs.en: Among all baselines, ProReFiCIA achieves the highest F 1 F_{1} score across the three datasets. Compared with the other three baselines using the T 2 T_{2} threshold selection strategy, it achieves an average F 1 F_{1} score of 55.0%, versus 31.6%, 27.7%, and 25.1% for LSI , SBERT , and LLM-Vec , respectively. This represents a substantial improvement, with ProReFiCIA achieving nearly twice the average F 1 F_{1} score of the three semantic similarity-based approaches. This difference is primarily caused by the significant difference in precision between ProReFiCIA and the other baselines. ProReFiCIA achieves an average precision of 41.33%, compared to 19.9%, 16.6%, and 15.1%, for LSI , SBERT , and LLM-Vaec, respectively. This can be attributed to its more balanced retrieval of true positives and false positives. Unlike the semantic similarity approaches, which tend to either miss relevant requirements or include too many irrelevant ones, ProReFiCIA produces a more precise impact set. After ProReFiCIA , and by a considerable margin, the next highest-performing baseline is LSI T2 , as indicated by the average F 1 F_{1} scores reported above. This suggests that richer semantic representations, without any further fine-tuning, do not necessarily translate to better retrieval performance in the CIA task. Among the remaining two pre-trained embedding models, SBERT T2 outperforms LLM-Vec T2 , with the latter achieving the lowest F 1 F_{1} score overall.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有基线方法中，ProReFiCIA 在三个数据集上均取得了最高的 F 1 F_{1} 分数。 与采用 T 2 T_{2} 阈值选择策略的其他三个基线方法相比，ProReFiCIA 的平均 F 1 F_{1} 分数为 55.0%，而 LSI、SBERT 和 LLM-Vec 分别为 31.6%、27.7% 和 25.1%。 这是一个显著的提升，ProReFiCIA 的平均 F 1 F_{1} 分数几乎是三种基于语义相似度的方法的两倍。 这种差异主要由 ProReFiCIA 与其他基线方法在精确率上的显著差异所导致。 ProReFiCIA 的平均精确率为 41.33%，而 LSI、SBERT 和 LLM-Vaec 分别为 19.9%、16.6% 和 15.1%。 这可以归因于它在真正例和假正例的检索上更加均衡。 与容易漏掉相关需求或纳入过多无关需求的语义相似度方法不同，ProReFiCIA 产生的影响集更加精确。 在 ProReFiCIA 之后，且以相当大的差距位居次席的基线方法是 LSI T2，正如上文报告的平均 F 1 F_{1} 分数所示。 这表明，在不进行任何进一步微调的情况下，更丰富的语义表示并不一定能在 CIA 任务中带来更好的检索性能。 在其余两个预训练嵌入模型中，SBERT T2 优于 LLM-Vec T2，后者的 F 1 F_{1} 分数在所有方法中最低。

paragraphs.en: In terms of cost, the same pattern holds: ProReFiCIA has the lowest cost at 10.9%, followed by LSI at 21.6%, SBERT at 28.9%, and LLM-Vec at 29.5%. Regarding effectiveness, a different pattern emerges, with approaches based on pre-trained embeddings achieving the highest effectiveness. SBERT T2 achieves the highest average effectiveness at 92.9%, followed by LLM-Vec T ​ 2 {T2} at 90.2%, ProReFiCIA at 89.3%, and LSI T2 at 89.3%. These results indicate that although pre-trained embedding models achieve lower F 1 F_{1} scores than other baselines, they can still provide highly effective impact-set retrieval. This may be because they capture richer semantic relationships between requirements than a simpler method such as LSI . Nevertheless, ProReFiCIA achieves the highest F 1 F_{1} score and lowest cost, making it the strongest overall baseline.

paragraphs.en: As Table 9 shows, DRILS achieves the best performance on most metrics across the three datasets, outperforming the baselines in 11 out of 15 metric-dataset combinations. DRILS achieves an average recall of 87.1%, an average precision of 76.3%, and an average F 1 F_{1} score of 80.9% across the three datasets. Compared to the best-performing baseline, ProReFiCIA , this corresponds to relative gains of 30.86%, 36.77%, and 82.0%. This difference is primarily due to the substantially higher precision achieved by DRILS . While all four baselines (using the T 2 T_{2} threshold selection strategy) achieve similar recall scores and even outperform DRILS on the ADB dataset, the difference is much more significant when considering precision. In fact, compared to ProReFiCIA , DRILS increases precision from 44.5% to 64.9% for APA, from 48.8% to 86.2% for TJA, and from 30.7% to 77.8% for ADB. These correspond to relative gains of 41.1%, 83.4%, and 149.8%, respectively. Thus, DRILS substantially improves precision while maintaining comparable recall, resulting in a considerably better balance between precision and recall. The difference is even more pronounced when considering other baselines. Precision is as low as 6.0% with LLM-Vec T ​ 1 {T1} for APA, 9.2% with SBERT T ​ 1 {T1} for TJA, and 12.0% with LLM-Vec T1 for ADB. Overall, DRILS achieves the highest F 1 F_{1} scores across the evaluated approaches, primarily due to its substantially higher precision, while maintaining high recall. These results demonstrate the advantage of DRILS in producing better impact sets compared to the baseline approaches.

paragraphs.en: In terms of effectiveness and cost, DRILS achieves the highest effectiveness on two of the three datasets and the lowest cost on all three. It yields an average effectiveness of 89.7% and an average cost of 6.0% across the three datasets. This means that on average, DRILS reviews 6.0% of the requirements list per change request while maintaining an effectiveness of approximately 90%. These results indicate that DRILS not only avoids overwhelming analysts with irrelevant requirements, but also retains the ability to identify the vast majority of truly impacted requirements. Although ProReFiCIA was specifically designed to reduce the cost of impact analysis, DRILS achieves substantially lower costs. In particular, DRILS reduces the cost by nearly half compared to ProReFiCIA for both the TJA and ADB datasets. The difference is even more pronounced than for other baselines, particularly LSI T1 , which achieves the lowest effectiveness and highest cost across all three datasets. Specifically, LSI T1 achieves an average effectiveness of only 54.0% at an average cost of 47.7%, compared to 89.7% effectiveness and 6.0% cost for DRILS . Overall, DRILS achieves a high effectiveness while providing significant cost savings compared to the baselines. Combined with its superior precision, these results demonstrate DRILS ’s ability to reduce false positives, thus reducing the effort required by requirements engineers to review the predicted impact set.
paragraphs.zh: 在有效性和成本方面，DRILS 在三个数据集中的两个上取得了最高的有效性，并且在全部三个数据集上成本最低。 在三个数据集上，它取得了平均 89.7% 的有效性和平均 6.0% 的成本。 这意味着，平均而言，DRILS 在每个变更请求中只审查 6.0% 的需求列表，同时保持约 90% 的有效性。 这些结果表明，DRILS 不仅避免了用不相关的需求使分析师不堪重负，而且保留了识别绝大多数真正受影响需求的能力。 尽管 ProReFiCIA 是专门为降低影响分析成本而设计的，但 DRILS 实现了明显更低的成本。 特别是，在 TJA 和 ADB 数据集上，DRILS 相比 ProReFiCIA 将成本降低了近一半。 与其他基线相比，这一差距更为显著，尤其是 LSI T1，它在所有三个数据集上取得了最低的有效性和最高的成本。 具体而言，LSI T1 的平均有效性仅为 54.0%，平均成本高达 47.7%，而 DRILS 的有效性为 89.7%，成本为 6.0%。 总体而言，DRILS 在实现高有效性的同时，与基线相比提供了显著的成本节约。 结合其卓越的精确率，这些结果证明了 DRILS 减少误报的能力，从而减少了需求工程师审查预测影响集所需的工作量。

paragraphs.en: To assess whether the performance difference between DRILS and ProReFiCIA , the highest-performing baseline, is statistically significant, we conducted Fisher’s Exact test. Specifically, Fisher’s exact test was used to determine whether the observed differences in precision and recall arise from statistically significant differences in the TP/FP and TP/FN proportions. Regarding recall, the p-values for all three datasets are above the significance threshold of 0.05. Therefore, there is no statistically significant difference in recall between the two approaches. In contrast, the p-values for precision across the three datasets are 2e-2, 3.3e-3, and 1e-4 for APA, TJA, and ADB, respectively. Since these values are below the significance threshold, the differences in precision are statistically significant for all three datasets. These results indicate that DRILS ’s superior F 1 F_{1} scores are driven by higher precision rather than a statistically significant improvement in recall. Together, these results, along with DRILS ’s highest F 1 F_{1} score, high effectiveness, and lowest cost, establish DRILS as the superior approach among the evaluated baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估 DRILS 与表现最佳的基线方法 ProReFiCIA 之间的性能差异是否具有统计显著性，我们进行了 Fisher 精确检验。 具体而言，Fisher 精确检验用于确定在精确率和召回率上观察到的差异是否源自 TP/FP 和 TP/FN 比例的统计显著差异。 在召回率方面，三个数据集的 p 值均高于 0.05 的显著性阈值。 因此，两种方法在召回率上不存在统计显著差异。 相比之下，三个数据集在精确率上的 p 值分别为：APA 为 2e-2，TJA 为 3.3e-3，ADB 为 1e-4。 由于这些值低于显著性阈值，三个数据集在精确率上的差异均具有统计显著性。 这些结果表明，DRILS 的 F 1 F_{1} 分数优势来自更高的精确率，而非召回率上的统计显著提升。 总之，这些结果连同 DRILS 最高的 F 1 F_{1} 分数、高效性和最低的成本，确立了 DRILS 是所评估基线中的最优方法。

paragraphs.en: DRILS comprises multiple steps, inputs, and outputs. Through extensive experimental evaluations, we demonstrated the usefulness of each of these elements. We further demonstrated that DRILS consistently outperformed state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines in terms of recall, F 1 F_{1} score, effectiveness, and cost, while achieving substantially higher precision.

paragraphs.en: Our evaluations demonstrate that auxiliary information provided by the generator agents contributes to the Judge Agent ’s decision-making. Including rationales improved precision, recall, and F 1 F_{1} score, with the most pronounced gains among the evaluated types of auxiliary information. Including change locations primarily improved recall, while including Confidence Scores improved recall, precision, and F 1 F_{1} score, albeit with slight differences. Each type of information gives the Judge Agent a different perspective: rationales explain the Generator Agents’ reasoning, change rationales provide more detail about the proposed change to the impacted requirement, and confidence scores indicate the agents’ confidence in their decisions. These types of information complement each other, as demonstrated by the more pronounced improvements across all evaluation metrics when they were included simultaneously.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估表明，生成智能体提供的辅助信息有助于 Judge 智能体的决策。 加入理由说明提升了精确率、召回率和 F 1 F_{1} 分数，在所评估的各类辅助信息中提升最为显著。 加入变更位置主要提升了召回率，而加入置信度分数则提升了召回率、精确率和 F 1 F_{1} 分数，尽管存在细微差异。 每类信息都为 Judge 智能体提供了不同的视角：理由说明解释了 Generator 智能体的推理过程，变更理由提供了对受影响需求的拟议变更的更多细节，而置信度分数则表明智能体对其决策的信心。 这些类型的信息相互补充，这体现在同时包含它们时，所有评估指标都出现了更显著的改进。

paragraphs.en: These findings highlight the importance of providing agents in LLM-as-a-judge setups with auxiliary information that offers transparency into the reasoning and confidence of preceding agents. Such information can help the Judge Agent make more informed decisions for CIA.

paragraphs.en: The experimental results show that RE-RAG improves the performance of DRILS compared with both chunk-based RAG and no RAG. RE-RAG provides superior overall performance, particularly in recall, producing more complete impact sets. Unconstrained context from chunk-based RAG yields results similar to those without RAG, potentially due to introduced noise, highlighting the importance of concise, structured context. RE-RAG particularly benefits the Judge Agent during impact set validation, rather than the Generator Agents during impact set identification. This may be explained by the higher quality of the auxiliary information produced by the Generator Agents when they receive concise and structured domain context as input.
paragraphs.zh: 实验结果表明，与基于分块的 RAG 和无 RAG 相比，RE-RAG 提升了 DRILS 的性能。 RE-RAG 提供了更优的整体性能，尤其在召回率方面表现突出，能够产生更完整的影响集。 来自基于分块的 RAG 的无约束上下文所产生的结果与不使用 RAG 的结果相近，这可能是由于引入了噪声，凸显了简洁、结构化上下文的重要性。 RE-RAG 主要在影响集验证阶段为裁判智能体带来收益，而非在影响集识别阶段为生成智能体带来收益。 这可以解释为：当生成智能体接收到简洁且结构化的领域上下文作为输入时，其所产生的辅助信息具有更高的质量。

sents.en: The experimental results show that RE-RAG improves the performance of DRILS compared with both chunk-based RAG and no RAG.
sents.zh: 实验结果表明，与基于分块的 RAG 和无 RAG 相比，RE-RAG 提升了 DRILS 的性能。

sents.en: RE-RAG provides superior overall performance, particularly in recall, producing more complete impact sets.
sents.zh: RE-RAG 提供了更优的整体性能，尤其在召回率方面表现突出，能够产生更完整的影响集。

sents.en: Unconstrained context from chunk-based RAG yields results similar to those without RAG, potentially due to introduced noise, highlighting the importance of concise, structured context.
sents.zh: 来自基于分块的 RAG 的无约束上下文所产生的结果与不使用 RAG 的结果相近，这可能是由于引入了噪声，凸显了简洁、结构化上下文的重要性。

sents.en: RE-RAG particularly benefits the Judge Agent during impact set validation, rather than the Generator Agents during impact set identification.
sents.zh: RE-RAG 主要在影响集验证阶段为裁判智能体带来收益，而非在影响集识别阶段为生成智能体带来收益。

sents.en: This may be explained by the higher quality of the auxiliary information produced by the Generator Agents when they receive concise and structured domain context as input.
sents.zh: 这可以解释为：当生成智能体接收到简洁且结构化的领域上下文作为输入时，其所产生的辅助信息具有更高的质量。

paragraphs.en: These findings highlight the importance of concise and structured context, as unconstrained context yields results similar to those obtained without context, potentially due to the noise introduced.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现凸显了简洁且结构化的上下文的重要性，因为不受约束的上下文所产生的结果与没有上下文时的结果相似，这可能是由于其引入的噪声所致。

paragraphs.en: The empirical results show that clustering the input requirements in DRILS yields higher recall, and thus a more complete impact set, compared with fixed-size batching and processing the entire requirements list at once. This may be because clustering reduces the amount of information the agents must process simultaneously while preserving the context of semantically similar requirements. This allows them to focus more effectively on requirements relevant to the change request while mitigating the lost-in-the-middle effect. Clustering particularly benefits impact-set validation by the Judge Agent , rather than impact-set generation by the Generator Agents . This may be due to higher-quality auxiliary information, as evidenced by higher confidence scores, which better differentiate true positives (TPs) from false positives (FPs).
paragraphs.zh: 实验结果表明，与固定大小的批处理以及一次性处理整个需求列表相比，在 DRILS 中对输入需求进行聚类能获得更高的召回率，从而得到更完整的影响集。 这可能是因为聚类在保留语义相似需求上下文的同时，减少了智能体必须同时处理的信息量。 这使智能体能够更有效地关注与变更请求相关的需求，同时缓解“中间丢失”效应。 聚类尤其有利于 Judge Agent 进行的 impact-set 验证，而非 Generator Agents 进行的 impact-set 生成。 这可能是由于辅助信息的质量更高（更高的置信度分数即为佐证），从而能更好地区分真阳性（TPs）与假阳性（FPs）。

sents.zh: 聚类尤其有利于 Judge Agent 进行的 impact-set 验证，而非 Generator Agents 进行的 impact-set 生成。

sents.en: This may be due to higher-quality auxiliary information, as evidenced by higher confidence scores, which better differentiate true positives (TPs) from false positives (FPs).
sents.zh: 这可能是由于辅助信息的质量更高（更高的置信度分数即为佐证），从而能更好地区分真阳性（TPs）与假阳性（FPs）。

paragraphs.en: These findings highlight the importance of considering semantic similarity when dividing requirements for processing, particularly in complex systems with a large number of requirements, as semantically similar requirements provide additional relevant context for CIA.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现强调了在对需求进行划分处理时考虑语义相似性的重要性，尤其是在包含大量需求的复杂系统中，因为语义相似的需求能为 CIA 提供额外的相关上下文。

paragraphs.en: The empirical results show that integrating a requirement dependency graph as additional knowledge improves DRILS ’s overall recall, precision, F 1 F_{1} score, and effectiveness. It benefits both impact set identification and validation. This may be attributed to the additional context provided by the RDG beyond the domain context, specifically the information regarding relationships between requirements. This context helps the agents identify additional requirements that may be impacted when a related requirement is deemed impacted. It can also support generating higher-quality, better-grounded auxiliary information, as shown by confidence scores that better distinguish true positives from false positives.
paragraphs.zh: 实证结果表明，将需求依赖图作为附加知识进行集成，提升了 DRILS 的整体召回率、精确率、F_{1} 分数和有效性。 这对影响集识别和验证都有帮助。 这可能归因于 RDG 在领域上下文之外提供的附加上下文，特别是关于需求之间关系的信息。 这种上下文帮助智能体识别出当一个相关需求被判定为受影响时，可能受影响的其他需求。 它还能支持生成质量更高、依据更充分的辅助信息，这一点从置信度分数能更好地区分真正例与假正例中可以看出。

paragraphs.en: These findings highlight the value of incorporating requirement dependencies into LLM-based change impact analysis, supporting both impact set identification and validation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现凸显了将需求依赖关系纳入基于大语言模型的变更影响分析的价值，既支持影响集识别，也支持影响集验证。

paragraphs.en: The empirical results show that DRILS outperforms multiple baselines across three categories: information retrieval, pre-trained embeddings, and LLMs. DRILS achieves higher recall, precision, F 1 F_{1} scores, and effectiveness, while incurring a lower cost. Although DRILS achieves high recall, averaging 87%, its main strength lies in precision, which is nearly twice that of the best-performing baseline. This substantially reduces the effort required by analysts to review the final impact set. Combined with the rationales explaining the selection of impacted requirements, DRILS facilitate the subsequent manual validation performed by analysts.
paragraphs.zh: 实验结果表明，DRILS 在三个类别（信息检索、预训练嵌入和大语言模型）上均优于多个基线方法。 DRILS 取得了更高的召回率、精确率、F 1 F_{1} 分数和有效性，同时成本更低。 尽管 DRILS 的召回率很高，平均达到 87%，但它的主要优势在于精确率，几乎是最优基线方法的两倍。 这大大减少了分析师审查最终影响集所需的工作量。 结合解释受影响需求选择依据的理由说明，DRILS 有助于分析师后续进行的人工验证。

paragraphs.en: These findings highlight the potential of LLMs for CIA, particularly when advanced techniques are employed to provide grounded context and leverage multi-agent architectures. Although manual validation remains necessary, LLM-based CIA, particularly DRILS , can substantially facilitate the task and automate a large part of the analysis, thereby reducing the manual verification effort required from analysts.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现凸显了大语言模型在 CIA 方面的潜力，尤其是当采用先进技术来提供有据可依的上下文并利用多智能体（multi-agent）架构时。 尽管人工验证仍然必不可少，但基于大语言模型的 CIA，尤其是 DRILS，能够极大地辅助这项任务并自动化大部分分析工作，从而减少分析师所需的人工核查工作量。

paragraphs.en: Internal Validity. One internal threat to validity concerns the design choices made for DRILS , particularly the integration of various inputs, outputs, and steps within its architecture. To mitigate this threat, we introduced these elements systematically and assessed their contributions through the extensive ablation studies conducted in RQ1, RQ2, and RQ3. Another threat is related to these ablation studies: whether the difference in performance can be attributed to the specific elements under investigation or due to external factors. To address this, we conducted controlled experiments in which all other inputs, steps, and prompts remained unchanged, except for the element being evaluated. Another threat arises from the stochastic nature of LLMs, which can lead to variations in results across runs. To mitigate this, we set the temperature to 0 to minimize randomness and re-ran all experiments three times. We report the average results and analyze the standard deviation, which was negligible, suggesting limited variability across runs and demonstrating the robustness of the experimental results. Finally, the observed performance differences between DRILS and the baseline approaches may be due to random variation. To mitigate this, we conducted Fisher’s exact test to assess statistical significance, providing stronger evidence that the reported improvements reflect genuine performance differences.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 一个内部效度威胁涉及 DRILS 的设计选择，尤其是其架构中各种输入、输出和步骤的整合方式。 为缓解这一威胁，我们系统地引入了这些要素，并通过在 RQ1、RQ2 和 RQ3 中开展的大规模消融研究评估了它们的贡献。 另一个威胁与这些消融研究有关：性能差异究竟是可归因于所研究的特定要素，还是由外部因素造成的。 为解决这一问题，我们进行了受控实验，除被评估的要素外，所有其他输入、步骤和提示词均保持不变。 另一个威胁源于大语言模型的随机性，它可能导致多次运行之间结果出现差异。 为缓解这一问题，我们将温度设置为 0 以尽量减少随机性，并将所有实验重复运行三次。 我们报告了平均结果并分析了标准差，其结果可以忽略不计，这表明多次运行之间的变化有限，证明了实验结果的稳健性。 最后，观察到的 DRILS 与基线方法之间的性能差异可能是由随机波动造成的。 为缓解这一问题，我们进行了 Fisher 精确检验以评估统计显著性，从而提供了更有力的证据，表明所报告的改进反映了真实的性能差异。

paragraphs.en: External Validity. The most critical threat to external validity concerns the generalizability of DRILS across new datasets. In this work, we evaluated DRILS on three different automotive datasets, covering a variety of systems with different numbers of requirements and dependencies. While the number of requirements in these datasets may not reflect the scale of larger industrial systems, we explicitly considered this challenge in the design of DRILS , particularly through the clustering mechanism introduced in Section 4.2 , which was designed to maintain effectiveness as the number of requirements grows. Nevertheless, evaluating DRILS on datasets from other domains remains an important direction for future work. Another threat concerns the three LLMs used in DRILS : GPT, Claude, and Gemini. Although these models were selected based on their demonstrated effectiveness and use in requirements engineering research, other LLMs may yield different results. Nevertheless, we expect the main findings to generalize to LLMs with comparable capabilities. As future work, we plan to evaluate additional proprietary and open-source LLMs to further assess the generalizability of our findings.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度。 对外部效度最严重的威胁涉及DRILS在新数据集上的可泛化性。 在本工作中，我们在三个不同的汽车数据集上评估了DRILS，这些数据集涵盖了具有不同需求数量和依赖关系的多种系统。 虽然这些数据集中的需求数量可能无法反映更大规模工业系统的体量，但我们在DRILS的设计中明确考虑了这一挑战，特别是通过第4.2节中引入的聚类机制，该机制旨在随着需求数量的增长而保持有效性。 尽管如此，在其他领域的数据集上评估DRILS仍然是未来工作的一个重要方向。 另一个威胁涉及DRILS中使用的三个大语言模型：GPT、Claude和Gemini。 虽然这些模型是根据其在需求工程研究中的已证实有效性和使用情况而选择的，但其他大语言模型可能会产生不同的结果。 尽管如此，我们预期主要发现可以泛化到具有类似能力的大语言模型。 作为未来的工作，我们计划评估更多的专有和开源大语言模型，以进一步评估我们发现的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Construct Validity. A threat to construct validity concerns our manual annotation of the ground truth impact sets for our datasets, which may introduce subjectivity and bias. To mitigate this, we followed a systematic, iterative annotation process, described in Section 3.2 , in which two researchers independently identified the impact sets and cross-validated their results through discussion until they reached consensus. Another threat concerns the replication of the baseline approaches. To mitigate this threat, we followed the implementation guidelines provided in the corresponding literature and official documentation, as described in Section 3.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 构思效度。 构思效度的一个威胁涉及我们为数据集手动标注真实影响集（ground truth impact sets），这可能引入主观性和偏差。 为缓解这一问题，我们遵循第3.2节所述的系统性、迭代式标注流程，由两名研究人员独立识别影响集，并通过讨论交叉验证各自的结果，直至达成共识。 另一个威胁涉及基线方法的复现。 为缓解这一威胁，我们遵循相关文献和官方文档中提供的实现指南，如第3.4节所述。

paragraphs.en: Arnold and Bohner ( Arnold, 1996 ; Bohner et al., 1996 ) laid the foundations of change impact analysis in 1993, defining it as a strategic process for evaluating the ripple effects of a modification and determining precisely which system artifacts require updates. In requirements engineering, CIA is particularly challenging because requirements are often complex, interdependent, and ambiguous due to the use of NL. To address these challenges, various CIA approaches were proposed in the literature. These approaches can be broadly grouped into four categories: model-based approaches ( Aryani et al., 2009 ; Nejati et al., 2016 ; Kchaou et al., 2017 ; Alkaf et al., 2019 ) , requirement dependency-based approaches ( Göknil et al., 2008 ; Goknil et al., 2011 ; Nonsiri et al., 2013 ; Goknil et al., 2014a ; Rahim et al., 2026 ) , NLP-based approaches ( Arora et al., 2015a ; Arora et al., 2015b ) , and LLM-based approaches ( Rusdianto et al., 2024 ; Etezadi et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: Arnold 和 Bohner（Arnold, 1996；Bohner et al., 1996）于 1993 年奠定了变更影响分析的基础，将其定义为一种评估修改的涟漪效应并精确确定哪些系统制品需要更新的战略过程。 在需求工程中，变更影响分析尤其具有挑战性，因为由于自然语言的使用，需求往往是复杂、相互依赖且模糊的。 为了应对这些挑战，文献中提出了各种变更影响分析方法。 这些方法大致可分为四类：基于模型的方法（Aryani et al., 2009；Nejati et al., 2016；Kchaou et al., 2017；Alkaf et al., 2019）、基于需求依赖的方法（Göknil et al., 2008；Goknil et al., 2011；Nonsiri et al., 2013；Goknil et al., 2014a；Rahim et al., 2026）、基于自然语言处理的方法（Arora et al., 2015a；Arora et al., 2015b）以及基于大语言模型的方法（Rusdianto et al., 2024；Etezadi et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Model-based approaches represent software artifacts, including requirements, using formal representations, which are analyzed using techniques such as static slicing and graph traversal to support CIA. Specifically, they leverage the structure and semantics of formal models to identify change impact across software artifacts. Early foundational work in this category was proposed by Aryani et al. ( Aryani et al., 2009 ) , a methodology for analyzing change propagation using domain-level behavioral models. These models capture the structural interactions between system components and are constructed by representing components and their behavioral dependencies at a conceptual level. Change propagation then traverses these behavioral dependencies, following how a change in one component influences others through their interactions, making the propagation mechanism primarily structural and topology-driven. Nejati et al. ( Nejati et al., 2016 ) also addressed cross-artifact CIA, specifically between SysML requirements and design models. The approach first applies a static slicing algorithm to extract the set of potentially impacted model elements. The identified candidate elements are then ranked using NLP applied to their textual content and manually inspected by analysts. This approach combines structural slicing for propagation with semantic similarity scoring for prioritization, making it a notable hybrid of structural and NLP-based analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 基于模型的方法使用形式化表示来表示包括需求在内的软件工件，并通过静态切片和图遍历等技术对其进行分析，以支持变更影响分析（CIA）。 具体而言，它们利用形式化模型的结构和语义来识别软件工件之间的变更影响。 该类别的早期奠基性工作由 Aryani 等人提出。 （Aryani 等人，2009）提出了一种使用领域级行为模型来分析变更传播的方法。 这些模型捕获系统组件之间的结构交互，并通过在概念层面表示组件及其行为依赖来构建。 变更传播随后遍历这些行为依赖，追踪一个组件的变更如何通过组件间的交互影响其他组件，使传播机制主要是结构化和拓扑驱动的。Nejati 等人。 （Nejati 等人，2016）还解决了跨工件的变更影响分析，特别是针对 SysML 需求与设计模型之间的分析。 该方法首先应用静态切片算法来提取可能受影响的模型元素集合。 然后使用自然语言处理（NLP）对识别出的候选元素的文本内容进行分析并排序，最后由分析师进行人工检查。 该方法将用于传播的结构化切片与用于优先级排序的语义相似度评分相结合，使其成为结构化分析与基于 NLP 的分析的显著混合方案。

paragraphs.en: Kchaou et al. ( Kchaou et al., 2017 ) support CIA across UML design artifacts by leveraging structural dependencies within and between UML diagrams. They employ an information retrieval (IR) technique that measures textual similarity between natural language descriptions associated with model elements. Lastly, Alkaf et al. ( Alkaf et al., 2019 ) proposed an automated CIA approach for requirements modeled using the User Requirements Notation (URN), a formalism that combines Use Case Maps (UCM) for expressing scenarios and Goal-oriented Requirement Language (GRL) for capturing the goals of actors and their relationships. Given a change to a URN construct, the approach uses forward slicing and URN traceability links to identify potentially impacted constructs within the selected view and across related GRL/UCM views.
paragraphs.zh: Kchaou 等人 （Kchaou 等，2017）通过利用 UML 图内部以及 UML 图之间的结构依赖关系，支持对 UML 设计制品进行 CIA（变更影响分析）。 他们采用一种信息检索（IR）技术，来度量与模型元素关联的自然语言描述之间的文本相似度。最后，Alkaf 等人 （Alkaf 等，2019）提出了一种针对使用用户需求符号（URN）建模的需求的自动化 CIA 方法，URN 是一种形式化表示，它结合了用于表达场景的用例图（UCM）和用于捕获参与者目标及其关系的面向目标需求语言（GRL）。 对于 URN 构造的变更，该方法使用前向切片和 URN 可追溯性链接，来识别所选视图内部以及相关 GRL/UCM 视图之间可能受到影响的构造。

paragraphs.en: Dependency-based techniques focus on explicitly defined relationships among requirements, such as refinement, conflict, or derivation, and use these relationships to trace how a change propagates from one requirement to others ( Göknil et al., 2008 ; Goknil et al., 2011 ) . They operate primarily at the requirement level, propagating changes through typed dependency links. For instance, Göknil et al. ( Göknil et al., 2008 ) formalized a subset of requirement relationships in first-order logic. Change propagation is performed through deductive rule-based inference, deriving the set of impacted requirements by applying logical rules to the formalized relationship semantics. Only a textual explanation of inconsistency propagation was provided, and no fully automated tool was developed. Similarly, Goknil et al. ( Goknil et al., 2011 ) proposed an approach that relies on first-order logic formalization of requirement relations and dependencies. They implemented a reasoning tool based on an OWL ontology that represents the requirement-dependency graph. Change propagation and consistency checking are performed through rule-based logical reasoning, leveraging OWL description logic to derive impacted requirements from formally encoded relationship semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 基于依赖关系的技术聚焦于需求之间明确定义的关系，例如细化、冲突或派生，并利用这些关系来追踪变更如何从一个需求传播到其他需求（Göknil et al., 2008；Goknil et al., 2011）。 它们主要在需求层面运作，通过带类型的依赖链接传播变更。 例如，Göknil 等人 （Göknil et al., 2008）在一阶逻辑中形式化了需求关系的一个子集。 变更传播通过基于演绎规则的推理来执行，通过将逻辑规则应用于形式化的关系语义来推导受影响的需求集合。 他们仅提供了不一致性传播的文本说明，并未开发完全自动化的工具。类似地，Goknil 等人 （Göknil et al., 2011）提出了一种依赖于一阶逻辑形式化需求关系与依赖关系的方法。 他们实现了一个基于 OWL 本体的推理工具，该本体表示需求-依赖图。 变更传播与一致性检查通过基于规则的逻辑推理来执行，利用 OWL 描述逻辑从形式化编码的关系语义中推导受影响的需求。

paragraphs.en: Multiple existing approaches are hybrid, combining both modeling and requirement dependencies for CIA. For instance, Nonsiri et al. ( Nonsiri et al., 2013 ) proposed a model-based approach for analyzing change propagation among requirements by automatically transforming SysML requirement diagrams into OWL ontologies. The transformation pipeline maps requirement elements and their relationships to ontological concepts and properties, constructing the dependency model without manual ontology authoring. Change propagation is then performed through rule-based reasoning. Goknil et al. ( Goknil et al., 2014a ) defined a meta-model governing the structure and semantics of requirement models, representing requirements and their dependencies as instances that conform to this meta-model. Change propagation is performed through a combination of model traversal and rule application over the meta-model structure. However, the approach requires analysts to align their requirement specifications with the prescribed meta-model. Finally, Rahim et al. ( Rahim et al., 2026 ) proposed an approach that automatically transforms SysML requirement diagrams into OWL ontologies by mapping SysML elements and their relationships to ontological concepts and properties to construct the dependency model. Once the ontology is built, change propagation is performed by an OWL reasoning engine executing predefined semantic change impact rules that encode how relationship types propagate a change from one element to others.
paragraphs.zh: 多种现有方法是混合式的，同时结合建模与需求依赖关系来进行CIA（变更影响分析）。 例如，Nonsiri 等人 （Nonsiri et al., 2013）提出了一种基于模型的方法，通过将 SysML 需求图自动转换为 OWL 本体来分析需求之间的变更传播。 该转换流程将需求元素及其关系映射到本体概念和属性，从而在无需人工编写本体的情况下构建依赖模型。 随后通过基于规则的推理执行变更传播。Goknil 等人 （Goknil et al., 2014a）定义了一个元模型，用于规范需求模型的结构与语义，并将需求及其依赖关系表示为符合该元模型的实例。 变更传播通过在该元模型结构上进行模型遍历与规则应用的组合来执行。 然而，该方法要求分析人员使其需求规格与规定的元模型保持一致。最后，Rahim 等人 （Rahim et al., 2026）提出了一种方法，通过将 SysML 元素及其关系映射到本体概念和属性来自动将 SysML 需求图转换为 OWL 本体，从而构建依赖模型。 本体构建完成后，由 OWL 推理引擎执行预定义的语义变更影响规则来完成变更传播，这些规则编码了各类关系类型如何将变更从一个元素传播到其他元素。

sents.zh: 本体构建完成后，由 OWL 推理引擎执行预定义的语义变更影响规则来完成变更传播，这些规则编码了各类关系类型如何将变更从一个元素传播到其他元素。

paragraphs.en: Natural Language Processing (NLP) approaches primarily focus on the textual and linguistic characteristics of requirements and change requests. NLP techniques support CIA by leveraging the lexical and syntactic features of requirements and change requests to identify potentially impacted requirements. For example, Arora et al. ( Arora et al., 2015a ; Arora et al., 2015b ) proposed an NLP-based approach that analyzes how changes affect natural language requirements. Their approach combined text chunking to extract noun phrases and verb phrases from change rationales and candidate requirements with analyst-defined change propagation conditions. These conditions used Boolean logic over phrases or their synonyms and enabled phrase-level, context-aware impact scoring that reflects the likelihood that each requirement is affected.
paragraphs.zh: 自然语言处理（NLP）方法主要关注需求与变更请求的文本和语言特征。 NLP 技术通过利用需求与变更请求的词汇和句法特征来识别可能受影响的需求，从而支持变更影响分析（CIA）。 例如，Arora 等人。 （Arora et al., 2015a；Arora et al., 2015b）提出了一种基于 NLP 的方法，用于分析变更如何影响自然语言需求。 他们的方法将从变更理由和候选需求中提取名词短语和动词短语的文本分块技术，与分析师定义的变更传播条件相结合。 这些条件基于短语或其同义词的布尔逻辑，实现了短语级别、上下文感知的影响评分，以反映每条需求受影响的可能性。

paragraphs.en: More recently, researchers have explored LLM-based approaches to CIA. These approaches leverage the natural language understanding and reasoning capabilities of LLMs to identify potentially impacted requirements. For instance, Rusdianto et al. ( Rusdianto et al., 2024 ) proposed an LLM-based framework that integrates GPT-4 with RAG to identify potentially impacted requirements and analyze the functional, business, technical, and stakeholder implications of requirement changes. Another example is ProReFiCIA ( Etezadi et al., 2025 ) , an LLM-based approach that follows a structured pipeline consisting of prompting, refinement, and natural language inference (NLI)-based filtering stages. This pipeline aims to accurately identify impacted requirements while maintaining high recall and reducing both false positives and the manual review effort associated with them.
paragraphs.zh: 近来，研究者们开始探索基于大语言模型的需求变更影响分析（CIA）方法。 这些方法利用大语言模型的自然语言理解与推理能力来识别可能受影响的需求。 例如，Rusdianto 等人 （Rusdianto et al., 2024）提出了一个基于大语言模型的框架，该框架将 GPT-4 与 RAG 相结合，以识别可能受影响的需求，并分析需求变更在功能、业务、技术以及干系人层面的影响。 另一个例子是 ProReFiCIA（Etezadi et al., 2025），这是一种基于大语言模型的方法，遵循由提示、精炼以及基于自然语言推理（NLI）的过滤阶段组成的结构化流程。 该流程旨在准确识别受影响的需求，同时保持较高的召回率，并减少假阳性及其带来的手动审查工作量。

paragraphs.en: The aforementioned approaches exhibit several limitations. Model-based approaches rely on formal representations that support systematic and accurate change impact analysis. However, they require requirements to conform to a specific modeling formalism (e.g., URN and SysML), limiting their applicability across different development contexts ( Aryani et al., 2009 ; Nejati et al., 2016 ; Rahim et al., 2026 ; Alkaf et al., 2019 ; Nonsiri et al., 2013 ; Goknil et al., 2014a ) . Furthermore, most of of these approaches address change propagation across software artifacts ( Aryani et al., 2009 ; Nejati et al., 2016 ; Rahim et al., 2026 ) , rather than requirement change impact identification, which is the focus of this study. Requirement dependency-based approaches leverage dependencies between requirements to provide meaningful context for CIA. However, these structural dependencies alone are generally insufficient to capture the full semantic implications of a change request, particularly when relevant relationships are implicit or informally expressed ( Göknil et al., 2008 ; Goknil et al., 2011 ; Nonsiri et al., 2013 ; Goknil et al., 2014a ) . Moreover, in industrial contexts, requirement dependencies are often incomplete and sparsely defined, making approaches that rely solely on them less applicable. NLP-based techniques offer greater flexibility in processing natural-language requirements but often rely on shallow linguistic features that fail to capture deeper semantic relationships. They also require substantial human involvement, limiting their scalability and application ( Arora et al., 2015a ; Arora et al., 2015b ) . Finally, recent LLM-based approaches rely on simple prompting and basic RAG, without retrieving richer contextual information or leveraging requirement dependencies, potentially overlooking impacted requirements ( Rusdianto et al., 2024 ; Etezadi et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 上述方法存在若干局限性。 基于模型的方法依赖形式化表示，能够支持系统而准确的变化影响分析。 然而，这些方法要需求符合特定的建模形式体系（如 URN 和 SysML），限制了它们在不同开发环境中的适用性（ Aryani et al., 2009 ; Nejati et al., 2016 ; Rahim et al., 2026 ; Alkaf et al., 2019 ; Nonsiri et al., 2013 ; Goknil et al., 2014a ）。 此外，这些方法大多关注软件制品之间的变化传播（ Aryani et al., 2009 ; Nejati et al., 2016 ; Rahim et al., 2026 ），而非需求变化影响识别，后者才是本研究的重点。 基于需求依赖的方法利用需求之间的依赖关系，为变化影响分析提供有意义的上下文。 然而，仅凭这些结构性依赖通常不足以捕捉变更请求的完整语义含义，尤其是当相关关系是隐式的或以非正式方式表达时（ Göknil et al., 2008 ; Goknil et al., 2011 ; Nonsiri et al., 2013 ; Goknil et al., 2014a ）。 而且，在工业环境中，需求依赖往往不完整且定义稀疏，使得仅依赖这些依赖关系的方法适用性较低。 基于自然语言处理（NLP）的技术在处理自然语言需求方面具有更大的灵活性，但往往依赖浅层语言特征，无法捕捉更深层的语义关系。 它们还需要大量的人工参与，限制了其可扩展性和应用（ Arora et al., 2015a ; Arora et al., 2015b ）。 最后，近期基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法仅依赖简单的提示和基础的检索增强生成（RAG），既未检索更丰富的上下文信息，也未利用需求依赖，可能会遗漏受影响的需求（ Rusdianto et al., 2024 ; Etezadi et al., 2025 ）。

paragraphs.en: DRILS addresses these gaps through three key features. First, it adopts an agentic framework that uses multiple LLM models, enabling enhanced reasoning over complex change requests. Second, it leverages domain and technical knowledge embedded within the SRS document through a tailored RAG technique (RE-RAG), retrieving contextually relevant information more effectively than conventional approaches. Third, it incorporates dependency graph information as a complementary source of evidence alongside semantic reasoning, rather than treating structural dependencies as the sole basis for impact analysis. Together, these features make DRILS a promising solution for requirements change impact analysis.
paragraphs.zh: DRILS 通过三项关键特性弥补了这些不足。 首先，它采用了一个使用多个 LLM 模型的智能体框架，从而能够对复杂的变更请求进行更强的推理。 其次，它通过一种定制的 RAG 技术（RE-RAG）利用 SRS 文档中嵌入的领域知识和技术知识，比传统方法更有效地检索上下文相关的信息。 第三，它将依赖图信息作为与语义推理相辅相成的证据来源，而不是把结构依赖作为影响分析的唯一依据。 这些特性共同使 DRILS 成为需求变更影响分析的一个有前景的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: This paper presented DRILS , an agentic LLM-based framework for requirements change impact analysis that leverages a requirements dependency graph. DRILS incorporates RE-RAG, a tailored retrieval-augmented generation technique, to enhance accuracy. Two distinct Generator Agents are employed for impact set identification to introduce diversity of reasoning within the framework. They are each guided by a dependency graph that captures inter-requirement relationships to improve the completeness of their generated impact sets. A Judge Agent filters out false positives from the generated results to improve the precision of impact set identification.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 DRILS，一个基于智能体大语言模型的需求变更影响分析框架，它利用需求依赖图。 DRILS 引入了 RE-RAG，一种定制的检索增强生成技术，以提高准确性。 框架中采用了两个不同的生成器智能体来进行影响集识别，以在框架内引入推理的多样性。 每个生成器智能体都由一个捕获需求间关系的依赖图来引导，以提高其生成的影响集的完整性。 一个裁判智能体从生成的结果中过滤掉误报，以提高影响集识别的精确度。

sents.en: This paper presented DRILS , an agentic LLM-based framework for requirements change impact analysis that leverages a requirements dependency graph.

sents.zh: 一个裁判智能体从生成的结果中过滤掉误报，以提高影响集识别的精确度。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated DRILS on three datasets drawn from the automotive domain. The experiments demonstrate that DRILS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, particularly in precision, while maintaining high recall. DRILS achieves an average F 1 F_{1} score of 81% across all three datasets, with individual scores of 76%, 85%, and 82%. The average recall and precision of DRILS are 87% and 76%, respectively, indicating that the framework is capable of identifying the vast majority of truly impacted requirements while maintaining strong precision. Moreover, the ablation experiments revealed that removing RE-RAG, clustering, or the Requirement Dependency Graph reduced recall and F 1 F_{1} score. Removing the auxiliary information produced by the generator agents also reduced recall, with a more pronounced relative decrease of 18% when all auxiliary information was removed simultaneously. These findings underscore the essential contribution of each component of DRILS to its overall performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个来自汽车领域的数据集上评估了 DRILS。 实验表明，DRILS 显著优于最先进的基线方法，尤其是在精确率方面，同时保持了较高的召回率。 DRILS 在全部三个数据集上的平均 F 1 F_{1} 分数为 81%，各数据集上的分数分别为 76%、85% 和 82%。 DRILS 的平均召回率和精确率分别为 87% 和 76%，表明该框架能够识别绝大多数真正受影响的需求，同时保持较强的精确率。 此外，消融实验表明，移除 RE-RAG、聚类或需求依赖图都会降低召回率和 F 1 F_{1} 分数。 移除智能体生成的辅助信息同样会降低召回率，当同时移除所有辅助信息时，相对降幅更为明显，达到 18%。 这些发现强调了 DRILS 的每个组件对其整体性能的重要贡献。

paragraphs.en: As future work, we plan to investigate alternative multi-agent configurations, including agent debate and the use of more than two generator agents, to assess their impact on DRILS ’ performance. We also aim to evaluate the generalizability of DRILS beyond the automotive domain using diverse datasets spanning a broader range of application domains and requirement characteristics. Furthermore, we plan to assess its performance with different proprietary and open-source LLMs to investigate the extent to which the results depend on the underlying models. Finally, we aim to extend DRILS towards end-to-end CIA across multiple software artifacts, including design, development, and testing artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 作为未来工作，我们计划研究其他多智能体配置，包括智能体辩论以及使用两个以上的生成器智能体，以评估它们对 DRILS 性能的影响。 我们还旨在利用覆盖更广泛应用领域和需求特征的多样化数据集，评估 DRILS 在汽车领域之外的泛化能力。 此外，我们计划评估其在不同专有和开源 LLM 下的性能，以探究结果在多大程度上依赖于底层模型。 最后，我们旨在将 DRILS 扩展为跨多个软件制品（包括设计、开发和测试制品）的端到端 CIA。

sents.en: As future work, we plan to investigate alternative multi-agent configurations, including agent debate and the use of more than two generator agents, to assess their impact on DRILS ’ performance.
sents.zh: 作为未来工作，我们计划研究其他多智能体配置，包括智能体辩论以及使用两个以上的生成器智能体，以评估它们对 DRILS 性能的影响。

sents.en: We also aim to evaluate the generalizability of DRILS beyond the automotive domain using diverse datasets spanning a broader range of application domains and requirement characteristics.
sents.zh: 我们还旨在利用覆盖更广泛应用领域和需求特征的多样化数据集，评估 DRILS 在汽车领域之外的泛化能力。

sents.en: Furthermore, we plan to assess its performance with different proprietary and open-source LLMs to investigate the extent to which the results depend on the underlying models.
sents.zh: 此外，我们计划评估其在不同专有和开源 LLM 下的性能，以探究结果在多大程度上依赖于底层模型。

sents.en: Finally, we aim to extend DRILS towards end-to-end CIA across multiple software artifacts, including design, development, and testing artifacts.
sents.zh: 最后，我们旨在将 DRILS 扩展为跨多个软件制品（包括设计、开发和测试制品）的端到端 CIA。
